title: HPV18-Positive Cervical Large Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma With Rapid Progression Despite Pembrolizumab Combined With Chemotherapy: A Case Report With Immunogenomic Insights.
abstract: ABSTRACT HPV18‐positive cervical large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is exceptionally rare. We report a 40‐years‐old woman with FIGO 2018 stage IVB LCNEC who progressed rapidly despite paclitaxel–carboplatin–bevacizumab plus pembrolizumab, followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy and later cytotoxic regimens. Biopsy showed chromogranin A and synaptophysin positivity, diffuse p16, and Ki‐67%~80%. Comprehensive profiling revealed very low tumor mutational burden (TMB, 1.21/Mb), microsatellite stability, no homologous recombination deficiency, and minimal PD‐L1 (~1%), consistent with a poorly immunogenic tumor microenvironment (TME). This profile may explain the limited effect of immune checkpoint inhibition in this histology. The case suggests that HPV or p16 positivity alone did not predict clinical benefit from pembrolizumab‐based therapy in advanced cervical LCNEC, and supports careful biological assessment before treatment selection. These observations provide practical guidance for clinicians and support evaluation of alternative or investigational strategies for this aggressive tumor.
journal: The journal of obstetrics and gynaecology research

title: Exploration of immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in patients with human papillomavirus type 16 infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade ≤1.
abstract: ABSTRACT Immune responses correlated with clearance of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) were sought in PVX2 immunotherapy-treated CIN ≤1 patients. PVX2 comprises intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted pNGVL4a-Sig/E7(detox)/HSP70 DNA vaccine (3 mg, weeks 0 and 4) and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein (TA-CIN; 100 μg week 8). Administering PVX2 to 12 women with HPV16+ CIN ≤1 elicited both antibody and CD8+ T-cell responses, including changes in TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and emergence of public clonotypes. HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6. Post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher, but none correlated with clearance. Neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with HPV16 clearance. While the fractions of expanded/new clonotypes were not associated with HPV16 clearance, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads was evident post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. High baseline serum MCP-1 associated with HPV16 persistence, and MIP-1β trended higher post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. IMPORTANCE HPV16 is a necessary cause of over half of all cervical cancers, and in even higher fractions of other anogenital and oropharyngeal cancers. Treatments for HPV16 infection and associated pre-cancerous lesions are needed given the disease burden and limitations of current treatments. Women with persistent HPV infections endure anxiety and stress due to frequent colposcopies, inconvenience, healthcare costs from active surveillance, and potential to transmit the virus to other sexual partners. Since a majority of patients can spontaneously clear their infections, administration of an immunotherapy may promote the elimination of otherwise persistent infections where disease can progress.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in patients with HPV16 infection and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade ≤1, addressing the need for better treatments given the limitations of current options and the anxiety caused by persistent infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A study was conducted in 12 women with HPV16-positive CIN ≤1, who received PVX2 immunotherapy comprising intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted DNA vaccine and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated immune responses including antibody titers, CD8+ T-cell responses, TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and public clonotypes, as well as serum cytokine levels before and after vaccination.
analysis.main_results: HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6; post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher but did not correlate with clearance, and neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with clearance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that while immune responses were elicited, only a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads post-vaccination was associated with clearance, suggesting a potential novel correlate of protection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of immunotherapies for persistent HPV16 infections by highlighting the importance of vaccine antigen-specific T-cell responses, potentially reducing the need for invasive procedures and transmission risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size (n=12) and limited follow-up, though the study provides direct immune response measurements and viral clearance data.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored immune correlates of viral clearance after PVX2 immunotherapy in 12 women with HPV16-positive CIN ≤1. The PVX2 regimen included HPV16 E7-targeted DNA vaccine and L2E7E6 fusion protein. While HPV16 clearance was observed in 5/11 participants at month 6, neither antibody titers nor TCR clonal diversity/expansion correlated with clearance. However, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads post-vaccination was associated with clearance, and high baseline serum MCP-1 was linked to persistence. The findings suggest vaccine-specific T-cell responses may be key to clearance, offering insights for improving immunotherapies against persistent HPV16 infections.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在确定 HPV16 感染和宫颈上皮内瘤变 ≤1 级患者在 PVX2 免疫治疗后病毒清除的免疫相关性,考虑到当前选择的局限性和持续感染引起的焦虑,解决对更好的 治疗 的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项研究对 12 名 HPV16 阳性 CIN ≤1 的女性进行了研究,她们接受了 PVX2 免疫疗法,其中包括肌肉注射 疫苗接种、HPV16 E7 靶向 DNA 疫苗 和 HPV16 L2E7E6 融合蛋白。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究评估了 免疫应答,包括抗体滴度、CD8+ T 细胞反应、TCR 多样性、克隆扩增和公共克隆型,以及 疫苗接种 前后的血清细胞因子水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 第 6 个月时,5/11 的可评估参与者中未检测到 HPV16;疫苗接种 后 E6、E7 和 L2 特异性抗体滴度较高,但与清除率无关,并且 TCR 克隆多样性/扩展和公共克隆型均与清除率无关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然引发了 免疫应答,但在 疫苗接种 后只有较高比例的 疫苗 抗原特异性读数与清除相关,这表明潜在的新型保护相关性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能通过强调 疫苗 抗原特异性 T 细胞反应的重要性,为持续性 HPV16 感染的免疫疗法的开发提供信息,从而有可能减少侵入性手术的需要和 传播 风险。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A study was conducted in 12 women with HPV16-positive CIN ≤1, who received PVX2 immunotherapy comprising intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted DNA vaccine and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein.
analysis_en.methods: The study evaluated immune responses including antibody titers, CD8+ T-cell responses, TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and public clonotypes, as well as serum cytokine levels before and after vaccination.
analysis_en.main_results: HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6; post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher but did not correlate with clearance, and neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with clearance.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that while immune responses were elicited, only a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads post-vaccination was associated with clearance, suggesting a potential novel correlate of protection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of immunotherapies for persistent HPV16 infections by highlighting the importance of vaccine antigen-specific T-cell responses, potentially reducing the need for invasive procedures and transmission risks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size (n=12) and limited follow-up, though the study provides direct immune response measurements and viral clearance data.

title_zh: 探索人乳头瘤病毒 16型感染且宫颈上皮内瘤变≤1级患者PVX2免疫治疗后病毒清除的免疫相关性。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Immune responses correlated with clearance of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) were sought in PVX2 immunotherapy-treated CIN ≤1 patients. PVX2 comprises intramuscular vaccinations with HPV16 E7-targeted pNGVL4a-Sig/E7(detox)/HSP70 DNA vaccine (3 mg, weeks 0 and 4) and HPV16 L2E7E6 fusion protein (TA-CIN; 100 μg week 8). Administering PVX2 to 12 women with HPV16+ CIN ≤1 elicited both antibody and CD8+ T-cell responses, including changes in TCR diversity, clonal expansion, and emergence of public clonotypes. HPV16 was not detected in 5/11 evaluable participants at month 6. Post-vaccination E6, E7, and L2-specific antibody titers were higher, but none correlated with clearance. Neither TCR clonal diversity/expansion nor public clonotypes were associated with HPV16 clearance. While the fractions of expanded/new clonotypes were not associated with HPV16 clearance, a higher proportion of vaccine antigen-specific reads was evident post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. High baseline serum MCP-1 associated with HPV16 persistence, and MIP-1β trended higher post-vaccination in those clearing HPV16. IMPORTANCE HPV16 is a necessary cause of over half of all cervical cancers, and in even higher fractions of other anogenital and oropharyngeal cancers. Treatments for HPV16 infection and associated pre-cancerous lesions are needed given the disease burden and limitations of current treatments. Women with persistent HPV infections endure anxiety and stress due to frequent colposcopies, inconvenience, healthcare costs from active surveillance, and potential to transmit the virus to other sexual partners. Since a majority of patients can spontaneously clear their infections, administration of an immunotherapy may promote the elimination of otherwise persistent infections where disease can progress.

title: Baseline characteristics of the HOMINY (human papillomavirus, human immunodeficiency virus, and oral microbiota interplay in Nigerian youth) prospective longitudinal cohort
abstract: Background The HOMINY (Human Papillomavirus, Human Immunodeficiency Virus, and Oral Microbiota Interplay in Nigerian Youth) cohort is a prospective longitudinal study established to investigate oral HPV infection and the oral microbiome among mother-child pairs with and without HIV in Nigeria. The objective of this analysis was to describe baseline demographic and clinical characteristics of the cohort, including HPV awareness, HPV vaccination, and cervical cancer screening practice by HIV status. Method Mothers (aged ≥ 18) and children (aged 9–18) were prospectively enrolled at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital. Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline demographic, behavioral, and HPV-related data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms. Group differences were assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests. Results A total of 1,075 participants were enrolled. Among mothers, 68% were HIV-positive. Awareness of HPV (<7%) and the HPV vaccine (3.0%) was low with fewer than 1% having received HPV vaccination, and only 19.1% reported ever undergoing cervical cancer screening. Mothers living with HIV reported younger age at sexual debut, more lifetime sexual partners, and lower education attainment than HIV-uninfected mothers. Among children, awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine was virtually absent, and only one child reported HPV vaccination. Birth characteristics differed by HIV status, with Caesarian sections and other perinatal exposures being higher among HIV-exposed groups. Conclusion Baseline findings demonstrate substantial gaps in HPV awareness, vaccination, and cervical cancer screening among families affected by HIV before implementation of Nigeria's national HPV vaccination program. This highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk, underscoring urgent needs for targeted HPV and HIV prevention in Nigerian youth. As the largest prospective mother-child cohort focused on oral HPV and HIV in sub-Saharan Africa, HOMINY provides an important foundation for future longitudinal studies of oral HPV infection, the oral microbiome, and the impact of HPV vaccination.

Method Mothers (aged ≥ 18) and children (aged 9–18) were prospectively enrolled at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital. Participants were grouped by HIV infection and exposure status. Baseline demographic, behavioral, and HPV-related data were collected using standardized questionnaires, medical record review, and case report forms. Group differences were assessed using parametric and non-parametric tests. Results A total of 1,075 participants were enrolled. Among mothers, 68% were HIV-positive. Awareness of HPV (<7%) and the HPV vaccine (3.0%) was low with fewer than 1% having received HPV vaccination, and only 19.1% reported ever undergoing cervical cancer screening. Mothers living with HIV reported younger age at sexual debut, more lifetime sexual partners, and lower education attainment than HIV-uninfected mothers. Among children, awareness of HPV and the HPV vaccine was virtually absent, and only one child reported HPV vaccination. Birth characteristics differed by HIV status, with Caesarian sections and other perinatal exposures being higher among HIV-exposed groups. Conclusion Baseline findings demonstrate substantial gaps in HPV awareness, vaccination, and cervical cancer screening among families affected by HIV before implementation of Nigeria's national HPV vaccination program. This highlights critical prevention gaps and sustained cancer risk, underscoring urgent needs for targeted HPV and HIV prevention in Nigerian youth. As the largest prospective mother-child cohort focused on oral HPV and HIV in sub-Saharan Africa, HOMINY provides an important foundation for future longitudinal studies of oral HPV infection, the oral microbiome, and the impact of HPV vaccination.

abstract_zh: 背景 HOMINY(人乳头瘤病毒,尼日利亚青少年中的人类免疫缺陷病毒和口腔微生物群的相互作用)队列研究 是一项前瞻性纵向研究,旨在调查尼日利亚感染和未感染 HIV 的母子对的口腔 HPV 感染和口腔微生物组。本分析的目的是描述 队列研究 的基线人口统计和临床特征,包括 HPV 认知、HPV 疫苗接种 和按 HIV 状态划分的 宫颈癌 筛查实践。方法 贝宁大学教学医院前瞻性招募母亲(≥ 18 岁)和儿童(9-18 岁)。参与者根据艾滋病毒感染和暴露状况进行分组。使用标准化问卷、病历审查和 病例报告 表格收集基线人口统计、行为和 HPV 相关数据。使用参数和非参数检验评估组间差异。结果 共有 1,075 名参与者入组。在母亲中,68% 的人艾滋病毒呈阳性。对 HPV (<7%) 和 HPV 疫苗 (3.0%) 的认知度较低,不到 1% 的人接受过 HPV 疫苗接种,并且只有 19.1% 的人报告曾接受过 宫颈癌 筛查。与未感染艾滋病毒的母亲相比,感染艾滋病毒的母亲首次性行为的年龄更小,终身性伴侣更多,受教育程度更低。在儿童中,对 HPV 和 HPV 疫苗 的认识几乎不存在,只有一名儿童报告了 HPV 疫苗接种。出生特征因艾滋病毒感染状况而异,剖腹产和其他围产期暴露在艾滋病毒暴露群体中较高。结论 基线结果表明,在实施尼日利亚国家 HPV 疫苗接种 计划之前,受 HIV 影响的家庭在 HPV 认识、疫苗接种 和 宫颈癌 筛查方面存在巨大差距。这突显了关键的预防差距和持续的癌症风险,凸显了尼日利亚青年迫切需要有针对性的 HPV 和 HIV 预防。作为撒哈拉以南非洲最大的专注于口腔 HPV 和 HIV 的前瞻性母子 队列研究,HOMINY 为未来口腔 HPV 感染、口腔微生物组和 HPV 疫苗接种 影响的纵向研究提供了重要基础。

title: Gynaecologists' Views and Acceptability of Active Surveillance for Women Diagnosed With Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia 2: A Qualitative Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Persistent oncogenic HPV infection can cause cervical epithelial changes leading to premalignant lesions such as CIN2. Active surveillance, a conservative option, reduces exposure to excisional risks while allowing timely treatment when needed. However, little is known about clinicians' perspectives, acceptability, and experience of offering active surveillance in the Australian healthcare context. AIMS: To explore gynaecologists' perspectives, acceptability, and experiences in providing active surveillance to women diagnosed with CIN2. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Individual semi-structured interviews were conducted with obstetrics and gynaecology specialists and trainees in secondary and tertiary healthcare settings across Australia. Data were analysed using inductive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Twenty-five in-depth interviews were conducted. Participants expressed positive views about active surveillance, regarding it as a safe option that does not increase long-term cancer risk. When formulating management recommendations for CIN2, participants considered various interrelated diagnostic, patient, clinician, and policy-level factors. To support shared decision-making, participants used several communication strategies such as anatomical models and visual images to help address patient knowledge gaps and they provided patients with time and space to reflect on their preferred management plan. Participants identified strategies that could support offering active surveillance and patients' adherence to this, including enhanced clinician education and training, increased resourcing, and improved use of information technology to support follow-up tests for active surveillance. CONCLUSIONS: A deeper understanding of multi-level factors influencing clinicians' recommendations and implementation of active surveillance for CIN2 may inform the development of targeted interventions to address barriers and strengthen enablers, ultimately supporting wider offering of active surveillance.

CONCLUSIONS: A deeper understanding of multi-level factors influencing clinicians' recommendations and implementation of active surveillance for CIN2 may inform the development of targeted interventions to address barriers and strengthen enablers, ultimately supporting wider offering of active surveillance.

title_zh: 妇科医生对活性 监测 对诊断为宫颈上皮内瘤变 2 的女性的看法和可接受性:一项定性研究。

Active surveillance, a conservative option, reduces exposure to excisional risks while allowing timely treatment when needed. AIMS: To explore gynaecologists' perspectives, acceptability, and experiences in providing active surveillance to women diagnosed with CIN2. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Individual semi-structured interviews were conducted with obstetrics and gynaecology specialists and trainees in secondary and tertiary healthcare settings across Australia. Data were analysed using inductive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Twenty-five in-depth interviews were conducted. Participants expressed positive views about active surveillance, regarding it as a safe option that does not increase long-term cancer risk. When formulating management recommendations for CIN2, participants considered various interrelated diagnostic, patient, clinician, and policy-level factors. To support shared decision-making, participants used several communication strategies such as anatomical models and visual images to help address patient knowledge gaps and they provided patients with time and space to reflect on their preferred management plan. Participants identified strategies that could support offering active surveillance and patients' adherence to this, including enhanced clinician education and training, increased resourcing, and improved use of information technology to support follow-up tests for active surveillance. CONCLUSIONS: A deeper understanding of multi-level factors influencing clinicians' recommendations and implementation of active surveillance for CIN2 may inform the development of targeted interventions to address barriers and strengthen enablers, ultimately supporting wider offering of active surveillance.
abstract_zh: 背景:持续致癌 HPV 感染可引起宫颈上皮变化,导致癌前病变,如 CIN2。主动 监测 是一种保守的选择,可减少切除风险,同时在需要时允许及时 治疗。然而,对于临床医生在澳大利亚医疗保健环境中提供活性 监测 的观点、可接受性和经验知之甚少。目的:探讨妇科医生在向诊断为 CIN2 的女性提供活性 监测 方面的观点、可接受性和经验。材料和方法:对澳大利亚二级和三级医疗机构的妇产科专家和实习生进行了单独的半结构化访谈。使用归纳主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:进行了二十五次深度访谈。参与者对活性 监测 表达了积极的看法,认为它是一种不会增加长期癌症风险的安全选择。在制定 CIN2 的管理建议时,参与者考虑了各种相互关联的诊断、患者、临床医生和政策层面的因素。为了支持共同决策,参与者使用了多种沟通策略,例如解剖模型和视觉图像来帮助解决患者知识差距,并为患者提供了时间和空间来反思他们首选的管理计划。参与者确定了可以支持提供活性 监测 和患者遵守这一策略的策略,包括加强临床医生教育和培训、增加资源以及改进信息技术的使用以支持活性 监测 的后续测试。结论:更深入地了解影响临床医生对 CIN2 的推荐和实施活性 监测 的多层次因素可能有助于制定有针对性的干预措施,以解决障碍并加强推动因素,最终支持更广泛地提供活性 监测。

title: Changing burden of cancers related to human papillomavirus in Estonia: a population-based registry study.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes multiple cancers. Understanding HPV-related cancer burden may help implement effective strategies for cancer prevention. The aim was to examine incidence and survival trends of eight HPV-related cancer sites in Estonia and estimate the number of cases attributable to HPV. Patient/material and methods: The Estonian Cancer Registry provided data on all cases of eight HPV-related cancer sites diagnosed in Estonia during 1995-2022. Age-standardized incidence trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, estimating annual percentage change (APC). The number of HPV-attributable cases was estimated using internationally derived site-specific attributable fractions, as tumor HPV status was not available. Five-year relative survival ratios were calculated from national life tables. RESULTS: In all, 11,266 cases of HPV-related cancer sites were diagnosed, of which 6,263 were estimated to be attributable to HPV; over 40% occurred before age 55. In women, estimated average annual number of HPV-attributable cases nearly quadrupled for oropharyngeal cancer (OPC) and tripled for anal cancer. A significant increase in OPC and anal cancer incidence was observed among women (APC 10.0 and 3.8, respectively). Cervical cancer incidence declined after 2012 (APC -5.6). Survival improved for OPC in men (from 13 to 44%) and vaginal cancer in women (from 45 to 73%). INTERPRETATION: HPV-related cancer patterns in Estonia are shifting from cervical to non-cervical cancers. Increasing oropharyngeal and anal cancer incidence highlights the need for prevention strategies beyond cervical screening alone. Strengthening HPV vaccination uptake and sustaining organized cervical screening are critical for reducing future cancer burden.

title: Women's experiences, responses, and coping strategies when testing positive for human papillomavirus in cervical cancer screening: A qualitative study.
abstract: Abstract Introduction Many countries, including Denmark, are adopting human papillomavirus‐based cervical screening due to its higher sensitivity compared to cytology. However, the sexually transmitted nature of HPV may evoke psychosexual distress. We aimed to explore: (1) women's psychosexual experiences, and (2) factors that shape their experiences and coping strategies in relation to routine cervical cancer screening. Material and Methods We conducted a qualitative study at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Gødstrup Hospital, Denmark from September 2024 to February 2025. We included women aged 30–60 referred to colposcopy due to a high‐risk HPV‐positive screening. Women were excluded if they had a previous history of excisional treatment. We conducted in‐depth semi‐structured interviews. All interviews were audiotaped and transcribed verbatim, after which a thematic analysis was performed using a phenomenological approach. Results We included 21 women with a median age of 42.5 years (range: 32–55 years). Receiving a high‐risk HPV result by mail left women without immediate support or information, causing feelings of anxiety about cancer risk, confusion about their health and next steps in treatment. The general practitioner (GP) was perceived as a source of reassurance, but was not always easily accessible. Recognizing the impact of HPV as a sexually transmitted virus triggered feelings of guilt, shame, and embarrassment, as well as sensations of uncleanliness and bodily disconnection. The diagnosis also strained relationships and disrupted sexual intimacy. Although the follow‐up gynecological consultation with colposcopy was reassuring, it was experienced as complex due to emotional burdens such as stigma and shame. A sense of needing to simply “comply” also hindered open discussion about the sexual nature of HPV and the expression of personal concerns. Conclusions Based on a practice theoretical framework, this study shows that women's experiences following a high‐risk HPV diagnosis in the context of cervical screening are not merely individual responses to medical information, but should be understood within a broader psychological, social, and cultural context that shapes how women process and cope with the diagnosis. These findings underscore the need for a holistic approach to patient care that fosters supportive and informative practices for women affected by HPV, coupled with a broader societal effort to reduce stigma and increase public awareness.

title: Unveiling Optimal Cervical Cancer Screening Age Range: Study of HPV Infection Among 75,719 Women in Indonesia's Metropolitan Regions (2012 - 2022).
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer, a global health crisis. Indonesia is placed as having the highest cervical cancer incidence and fatality in Southeast Asia. Currently, under the National Cervical Cancer Elimination (NCCE) plan, Indonesia has extended HPV DNA-based screening from 30-50 to 30-69 years old. However, various factors can lead to inadequate virus clearance in younger populations, and Indonesia has not yet had a large-scale analysis of age-specific HPV infection reports, leaving the ideal screening age uncertain. Therefore, this study aims to investigate age-specific HPV prevalence in Indonesia to inform the optimal age range for cervical cancer screening. METHODS: In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 75,719 subjects' data were utilized from all metropolitan regions in Indonesia from 2012-2020, who were tested with HPV DNA using PCR (SPF10-DEIA-LiPA25) and hybridization. The data were then analyzed by age and HPV genotype using IBM SPSS 27.0. RESULTS: 12.62% of 75,719 women aged 13-75 are HPV-positive. Women aged 30-39 (39.56%) and 40-49 (21.1%) had the highest infection rates, followed by 25-29 (18.9%) and those below 25 years (8.8%). This contrasts with the infection rates of women aged 60-65 (1.5%) and 66-69 (0.6%). Across all age categories, HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the most prevalent high-risk genotypes, with substantial variations in infection rates (p <0.001). High-risk HPV outnumbered low-risk HPV in all age categories. CONCLUSION: HPV-positive prevalence in the younger population, particularly among those aged 25-29, is frequent in Indonesia. After age 65, HPV-positive cases drop significantly. Several variables contribute to this. This study recommends adjusting cervical cancer screening to Indonesian women aged 25-65.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer, a global health crisis, and Indonesia has the highest incidence and fatality in Southeast Asia. However, the ideal screening age range remains uncertain due to insufficient age-specific HPV infection data in Indonesia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cross-sectional study utilized data from 75,719 women aged 13-75 across Indonesia's metropolitan regions from 2012-2020, who were tested for HPV DNA using PCR (SPF10-DEIA-LiPA25) and hybridization.
analysis.methods: The data were analyzed by age and HPV genotype using IBM SPSS 27.0 to determine age-specific prevalence and genotype distribution.
analysis.main_results: 12.62% of 75,719 women were HPV-positive, with the highest rates in women aged 30-39 (39.56%) and 40-49 (21.1%), followed by 25-29 (18.9%) and below 25 (8.8%), while rates dropped significantly after age 65 (1.5% and 0.6% for 60-65 and 66-69, respectively).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the frequent HPV positivity in younger populations (25-29) and significant decline after age 65 as evidence for adjusting screening age ranges, highlighting the novelty of large-scale age-specific HPV data in Indonesia.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cervical cancer screening in Indonesia should focus on women aged 25-65, optimizing resource allocation and early detection based on age-specific HPV prevalence.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's retrospective cross-sectional design limits causal inference, but the large sample size and comprehensive age analysis provide moderate confidence in the age-specific prevalence estimates.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated age-specific HPV prevalence in Indonesia to inform optimal cervical cancer screening age ranges. Using data from 75,719 women across metropolitan regions (2012-2020), HPV DNA testing revealed 12.62% positivity, with peaks in women aged 30-39 (39.56%) and 40-49 (21.1%), and significant declines after age 65. High-risk HPV genotypes (HPV52, HPV16, HPV58) dominated across all ages. The authors recommend adjusting screening to women aged 25-65, balancing high prevalence in younger populations with low rates in older women. This large-scale analysis provides critical data for Indonesia's National Cervical Cancer Elimination plan.

abstract_zh: 目标:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是导致全球健康危机 宫颈癌 的主要原因。印度尼西亚被列为东南亚 宫颈癌 发病率 和死亡率最高的国家。目前,根据国家宫颈癌消除(NCCE)计划,印度尼西亚已将基于HPV DNA的筛查从30-50岁扩大到30-69岁。然而,多种因素可能导致较年轻人群的病毒清除不足,而且印度尼西亚尚未对特定年龄的HPV感染报告进行大规模分析,使得理想的筛查年龄不确定。因此,本研究旨在调查印度尼西亚的年龄特异性 HPV 患病率,以了解 宫颈癌 筛查的最佳年龄范围。方法:在这项回顾性横断面研究中,利用了 2012 年至 2020 年印度尼西亚所有大都市区的 75,719 名受试者的数据,通过 PCR (SPF10-DEIA-LiPA25) 和杂交对他们进行了 HPV DNA 检测。然后使用 IBM SPSS 27.0 按年龄和 HPV 基因型对数据进行分析。结果:75,719 名 13-75 岁女性中,12.62% HPV 阳性。30-39岁(39.56%)和40-49岁(21.1%)女性感染率最高,其次是25-29岁(18.9%)和25岁以下(8.8%)。这与 60-65 岁(1.5%)和 66-69 岁(0.6%)女性的感染率形成鲜明对比。在所有年龄组中,HPV52、HPV16 和 HPV58 是最常见的高危基因型,感染率差异很大 (p <0.001)。在所有年龄组中,高危型HPV 的数量都超过了低危 HPV。结论:HPV 阳性 患病率 在印度尼西亚的年轻人中,尤其是 25-29 岁的人群中很常见。65 岁以后,HPV 阳性病例显着下降。有几个变量促成了这一点。本研究建议调整 25-65 岁印度尼西亚女性的 宫颈癌 筛查。

title: Nanomaterials for the Prevention, Detection, and Treatment of Pharyngeal Human Papillomavirus Infection: A Translational Roadmap
abstract: Pharyngeal infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16, is biologically distinct from cervical infection because it occurs within the specialized lymphoepithelial environment of Waldeyer’s ring. This review evaluates nanoparticle materials for the prevention, detection, and treatment of pharyngeal HPV, with an emphasis on structure–property–function relationships, mucosal performance, and translational feasibility. Lipid nanoparticle platforms, polymeric nanoparticle platforms, inorganic systems, and hybrid platforms are compared with respect to composition, particle size distribution, surface charge, colloidal stability, biodegradability, payload compatibility, release behavior, and manufacturing complexity. Evidence suggests that lipid and polymeric systems are the most credible near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and localized nucleic acid delivery because they offer the best balance between controllable fabrication, analytical tractability, and biologically plausible performance in mucus-exposed tissue. By contrast, the development of inorganic theranostics and CRISPR-enabled platforms remains at an earlier stage because repeated mucosal dosing, retention in lymphoid tissue, and combined product regulation impose substantial burdens. A translational roadmap is proposed in which material selection is guided by clinically relevant quality attributes, standardized saliva- and mucus-relevant assays, human tonsil organoid testing, and early attention to manufacturability, safety, and regulatory strategy. The field is promising, but direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited; accordingly, there is an urgent need for comparative studies that connect nanoparticle architecture to measurable outcomes such as tonsillar deposition, epithelial uptake, immune activation, and local tolerability.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的咽部感染,特别是 HPV16,由于其发生在韦氏环中,因此在生物学上与宫颈感染不同。核心问题涉及评估用于预防、检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 咽部 HPV 的纳米材料,强调结构-特性-功能关系、粘膜性能和转化可行性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述评估了用于咽部 HPV 的纳米颗粒材料,根据成分、粒径分布、表面电荷、胶体稳定性、生物降解性、有效负载兼容性、释放行为和制造复杂性,比较了脂质纳米颗粒平台、聚合物纳米颗粒平台、无机系统和混合平台。

title_zh: 用于预防、检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 咽部感染的纳米材料:转化路线图
source_body_en: Pharyngeal infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16, is biologically distinct from cervical infection because it occurs within the specialized lymphoepithelial environment of Waldeyer’s ring. This review evaluates nanoparticle materials for the prevention, detection, and treatment of pharyngeal HPV, with an emphasis on structure–property–function relationships, mucosal performance, and translational feasibility. Lipid nanoparticle platforms, polymeric nanoparticle platforms, inorganic systems, and hybrid platforms are compared with respect to composition, particle size distribution, surface charge, colloidal stability, biodegradability, payload compatibility, release behavior, and manufacturing complexity. Evidence suggests that lipid and polymeric systems are the most credible near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and localized nucleic acid delivery because they offer the best balance between controllable fabrication, analytical tractability, and biologically plausible performance in mucus-exposed tissue. By contrast, the development of inorganic theranostics and CRISPR-enabled platforms remains at an earlier stage because repeated mucosal dosing, retention in lymphoid tissue, and combined product regulation impose substantial burdens. A translational roadmap is proposed in which material selection is guided by clinically relevant quality attributes, standardized saliva- and mucus-relevant assays, human tonsil organoid testing, and early attention to manufacturability, safety, and regulatory strategy. The field is promising, but direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited; accordingly, there is an urgent need for comparative studies that connect nanoparticle architecture to measurable outcomes such as tonsillar deposition, epithelial uptake, immune activation, and local tolerability.

title: Immunohistochemical detection of high-risk human papillomavirus E6/E7 oncoproteins is associated with aggressive clinicopathological features in prostate cancer: a Sudanese cohort study
abstract: Abstract Background The role of human papillomavirus (HPV) in prostate cancer development remains uncertain, despite accumulating evidence of a potential link in certain populations. While HPV is a known cause of several epithelial cancers, its connection to prostate cancer (PCa) has not been definitively proven. This research assessed the immunohistochemical presence of high-risk HPV E6/E7 oncoproteins in prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) tissues from a Sudanese cohort and explored their association with clinicopathological features. Methods A retrospective case-control study involved 100 prostate tissue specimens fixed in formalin and embedded in paraffin, consisting of 50 histologically confirmed PCa cases and 50 BPH controls. The expression of high-risk HPV E6/E7 proteins was assessed by immunohistochemistry with monoclonal antibodies, and staining was semi-quantitatively scored using the H-score system. The relationship between HPV immunoreactivity and clinicopathological variables was analyzed with various statistical tests, including chi-square, Mann-Whitney U tests, logistic regression, and odds ratio calculations. Results High-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was significantly more common in prostate cancer than in benign prostatic hyperplasia (48% vs. Prostate cancer tissues had over four times higher odds of HPV positivity compared to benign tissues (OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.69–10.43). Positive immunostaining was notably associated with higher Gleason Grade groups (p = 0.0035) and advanced tumor stages (p = 0.004), while no significant link was found with serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels. Multivariable logistic regression confirmed that higher tumor grade and pathological stage were independently associated with HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity, even after adjustment for PSA. Conclusions In this Sudanese cohort, high-risk HPV E6/E7 immunoreactivity was associated with prostate cancer and more severe pathological features. These results suggest a possible connection between HPV-related protein expression and aggressive tumor traits. However, since immunohistochemistry alone cannot confirm active HPV infection or prove its causal role in prostate cancer development, caution is needed when interpreting these findings. Future research should include molecular HPV detection, viral genotyping, and RNA-based studies to better understand HPV's biological role in prostate cancer.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要进一步进行分子 HPV 检测和基因分型研究,以阐明 HPV 在前列腺癌中的生物学作用,并可能为 HPV 相关前列腺癌的 监测 策略和治疗方法提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于该研究的回顾性设计和对免疫组织化学的依赖,证据强度中等,无法确认活动性 HPV 感染或建立因果关系;局限性包括无法证明 HPV 的因果作用以及需要更全面的分子方法。

title: Cytology-negative lower-genital-tract lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection: genotype-specific and multicentric associations
abstract: Abstract Background Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection after menopause is clinically challenging because epithelial atrophy, sampling difficulty, and transformation-zone migration may reduce the reassurance provided by cytology. Although HPV genotyping is now central to risk-based management, lesion burden among cytology-negative postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection remains insufficiently characterized, particularly when cervical, vaginal, and vulvar disease are assessed together. Methods We conducted a retrospective study of postmenopausal women with persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection who were managed in the gynecological outpatient department of Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine, University Town Branch, from 2023 to 2025. Persistent infection was defined as same-genotype HPV infection lasting at least 12 completed calendar months between the recorded infection-start date and the index visit. Cytology-negative status was defined as negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM) on ThinPrep cytologic testing. The primary pathological outcome was lesion status and grade, classified as no HPV-related lesion, low-grade lesion (LSIL/low-grade lesion), or high-grade lesion (HSIL/high-grade lesion). Secondary outcomes included anatomic lesion site and multicentric lower-genital-tract involvement, defined as HPV-related lesions involving at least two distinct genital sites among the cervix, vagina, and vulva. Results All 353 screened records met the persistent-infection definition. NILM cytology was present in 223 women (63.2%). Among women with NILM cytology, 134 (60.1%) had no HPV-related lesion, 89 (39.9%) had an HPV-related lower genital tract lesion, 79 (35.4%) had a low-grade lesion, 10 (4.5%) had a high-grade lesion, and 22 (9.9%) had multicentric involvement. Compared with women with NILM cytology, women with abnormal cytology had higher odds of low-grade lesion (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.21–2.92) and high-grade lesion (OR 4.58, 95% CI 2.10–9.97). HPV16/18 positivity was associated with any lesion in the overall cohort (OR 3.02, 95% CI 1.87–4.87) and among NILM women (OR 2.72, 95% CI 1.53–4.84). Multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement in the overall cohort (OR 2.00, 95% CI 1.05–3.78) and in the NILM subgroup (OR 2.79, 95% CI 1.14–6.82). Conclusions NILM cytology did not exclude clinically meaningful lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection. HPV16/18 positivity identified women with higher lesion odds, whereas multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement. These findings support assessment that considers both HPV genotype and the full lower genital tract in postmenopausal persistent HPV management.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于上皮萎缩、取样困难和转化区迁移,绝经后持续的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染在临床上具有挑战性,这可能会降低细胞学提供的保证。该研究旨在描述持续感染 HPV 的细胞学阴性绝经后女性的病变负担,特别是同时评估宫颈、阴道和外阴疾病时。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023年至2025年广东省中医院大学城分院妇科门诊治疗的绝经后HPV持续感染女性进行回顾性研究。所有353份筛查记录均符合持续感染定义,其中223名女性(63.2%)存在NILM细胞学检查。
elements_zh.methods: 持续感染被定义为相同基因型 HPV 感染在记录的感染开始日期和首次就诊之间持续至少 12 个完整的日历月。细胞学阴性状态定义为 ThinPrep 细胞学检测上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤 (NILM) 呈阴性。主要病理结果是病变状态和级别,分为无HPV相关病变、低级别病变(LSIL/低级别病变)或高级别病变(HSIL/高级别病变)。
elements_zh.main_results: Among women with NILM cytology, 134 (60.1%) had no HPV-related lesion, 89 (39.9%) had an HPV-related lower genital tract lesion, 79 (35.4%) had a low-grade lesion, 10 (4.5%) had a high-grade lesion, and 22 (9.9%) had multicentric involvement. Women with abnormal cytology had higher odds of low-grade lesion (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.21–2.92) and high-grade lesion (OR 4.58, 95% CI 2.10–9.97).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,NILM 细胞学检查并不能排除持续 HPV 感染的绝经后妇女中具有临床意义的病变负担。他们还指出,HPV16/18 阳性表明女性的病变几率较高,而多重 HPV 感染与多中心受累相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在绝经后持续 HPV 管理中考虑 HPV 基因型和整个下生殖道的评估,这可以为更准确的 监测 和 诊断 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。由于缺乏前瞻性数据且依赖现有记录,证据强度中等。

Compared with women with NILM cytology, women with abnormal cytology had higher odds of low-grade lesion (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.21–2.92) and high-grade lesion (OR 4.58, 95% CI 2.10–9.97). HPV16/18 positivity was associated with any lesion in the overall cohort (OR 3.02, 95% CI 1.87–4.87) and among NILM women (OR 2.72, 95% CI 1.53–4.84). Multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement in the overall cohort (OR 2.00, 95% CI 1.05–3.78) and in the NILM subgroup (OR 2.79, 95% CI 1.14–6.82). Conclusions NILM cytology did not exclude clinically meaningful lesion burden in postmenopausal women with persistent HPV infection. HPV16/18 positivity identified women with higher lesion odds, whereas multiple HPV infection was associated with multicentric involvement. These findings support assessment that considers both HPV genotype and the full lower genital tract in postmenopausal persistent HPV management.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于上皮萎缩、取样困难和转化区迁移,绝经后持续的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染在临床上具有挑战性,这可能会降低细胞学提供的保证。该研究旨在描述持续感染 HPV 的细胞学阴性绝经后女性的病变负担,特别是同时评估宫颈、阴道和外阴疾病时。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023年至2025年广东省中医院大学城分院妇科门诊治疗的绝经后HPV持续感染女性进行回顾性研究。所有353份筛查记录均符合持续感染定义,其中223名女性(63.2%)存在NILM细胞学检查。
analysis_zh.methods: 持续感染被定义为相同基因型 HPV 感染在记录的感染开始日期和首次就诊之间持续至少 12 个完整的日历月。细胞学阴性状态定义为 ThinPrep 细胞学检测上皮内病变或恶性肿瘤 (NILM) 呈阴性。主要病理结果是病变状态和级别,分为无HPV相关病变、低级别病变(LSIL/低级别病变)或高级别病变(HSIL/高级别病变)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,NILM 细胞学检查并不能排除持续 HPV 感染的绝经后妇女中具有临床意义的病变负担。他们还指出,HPV16/18 阳性表明女性的病变几率较高,而多重 HPV 感染与多中心受累相关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持在绝经后持续 HPV 管理中考虑 HPV 基因型和整个下生殖道的评估,这可以为更准确的 监测 和 诊断 策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。由于缺乏前瞻性数据且依赖现有记录,证据强度中等。

title: '...but look how many lives would have been saved if this was available then' Exploring the acceptability of future Human Papillomavirus self-sampling, and the barriers and facilitators of cervical cancer screening for those with intellectual disabilities in Scotland.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer screening attendance among women with intellectual disabilities (ID) in Scotland is approximately 30%, significantly below the general population rate of 69% and the WHO's recommended 70% target. HPV self-sampling could provide a more accessible screening option for this underserved population. This study aimed to understand the views and experiences of women with ID regarding cervical cancer screening and the acceptability of HPV self-sampling. METHODS: A qualitative study using focus groups was conducted with women with ID who attended third-sector community groups across Scotland, along with their carers. Four focus groups were held between September and October 2024, with a total of 13 participants (11 women with ID, 2 carers). Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. RESULTS: Five main themes emerged: (1) National Health Service (NHS) communication as a source of distress; (2) power imbalances between health care providers and women with ID: feeling unheard, dismissed and out of control; (3) enduring consequences of inadequate care; (4) past trauma shapes future avoidance; and (5) self-sampling as a pathway to empowerment. Participants demonstrated high acceptability of self-sampling, viewing it as a potential solution to overcome barriers to traditional screening. CONCLUSION: This research reveals significant systemic inadequacies in current cervical cancer screening services for women with ID, whilst highlighting self-sampling's transformative potential. Successful implementation requires comprehensive accessible information, enhanced health care professional training and trauma-informed care approaches. Self-sampling could significantly advance health equity goals whilst improving health care outcomes for this underserved population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 参加 宫颈癌 筛查的比例约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比例和世界卫生组织 70% 的目标。该研究旨在探索筛查的障碍和促进因素,并评估未来 HPV 自我采样作为这一服务不足群体更容易获得的选择的可接受性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过焦点小组对苏格兰各地的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,涉及 13 名参与者(11 名患有智障的女性和 2 名护理人员)。
elements_zh.methods: 通过焦点小组收集数据,并使用反思性主题分析进行分析,以确定与筛查经验和自我抽样可接受性相关的关键主题。
elements_zh.main_results: 出现了五个主题:NHS 沟通是痛苦的根源;医疗保健提供者和智障女性之间的权力失衡;护理不足造成的持久后果;过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了当前针对智障女性的 宫颈癌 筛查服务存在系统性不足,同时将自我采样确定为一种变革性的潜在解决方案。新颖之处在于集中智障女性的声音来揭示未满足的需求并提出可行的改变。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过解决 宫颈癌 筛查项目中的准入障碍和创伤知情护理差距,自我采样可以推进健康公平目标并改善患有智力障碍的女性的医疗保健结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 定性设计限制了普遍性,而且样本量较小(n = 13)可能无法捕捉智力障碍女性经历的全部多样性。由于缺乏定量验证并且依赖自我报告的观点,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景:苏格兰智障女性 (ID) 的 宫颈癌 筛查出勤率约为 30%,远低于总人口 69% 的比率和世界卫生组织建议的 70% 目标。HPV 自我采样可以为这一服务不足的人群提供更方便的筛查选择。本研究旨在了解患有 ID 的女性对 宫颈癌 筛查以及 HPV 自我采样的可接受性的看法和经验。方法:利用焦点小组对参与苏格兰第三部门社区团体的智障女性及其护理人员进行了一项定性研究。2024 年 9 月至 10 月期间举办了四次焦点小组,共有 13 名参与者(11 名患有智力障碍的女性,2 名护理人员)。使用反思性主题分析对数据进行分析。结果:出现了五个主题:(1) 国家卫生服务 (NHS) 沟通是痛苦的根源;(2) 医疗保健提供者和智障妇女之间的权力失衡:感觉被忽视、被忽视和失控;(3) 护理不足造成的持久后果;(4)过去的创伤塑造了未来的回避;(5) 自我抽样作为赋权的途径。参与者表现出对自我采样的高度接受度,将其视为克服传统筛查障碍的潜在解决方案。结论:这项研究揭示了当前 宫颈癌 针对 ID 女性的筛查服务存在显着的系统性缺陷,同时强调了自我采样的变革潜力。成功的实施需要全面的可获取信息、加强的医疗保健专业培训和创伤知情护理方法。自我采样可以显着推进健康公平目标,同时改善这一服务不足人群的医疗保健结果。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过解决 宫颈癌 筛查项目中的准入障碍和创伤知情护理差距,自我采样可以推进健康公平目标并改善患有智力障碍的女性的医疗保健结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 定性设计限制了普遍性,而且样本量较小(n = 13)可能无法捕捉智力障碍女性经历的全部多样性。由于缺乏定量验证并且依赖自我报告的观点,证据强度中等。

title: Epigenetic Modification and Host Gene Silencing Profile Induced by High-Risk HPV Strains in Cervical Cancer
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary driver of cervical cancer; however, viral presence alone is insufficient to induce malignancy. The progression from initial infection to invasive carcinoma requires a coordinated series of alterations in both the viral genome and the host cell's regulatory machinery. This review focuses on three principal mechanisms by which HR-HPV bypasses host regulatory controls: epigenetic modifications, immune evasion, and endocrine signaling. Specifically, we describe how the viral oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host DNA methyltransferases—particularly DNMT1, DNMT3A, and DNMT3B—to silence tumor suppressor genes such as CCNA, hTERT, and E-cadherin via promoter hypermethylation. Beyond DNA methylation, HPV disrupts histone acetylation and methylation patterns through interactions with p300/CBP, the NuRD complex, and Polycomb group proteins, while simultaneously dysregulating non-coding RNAs and specific microRNAs to reinforce this transcriptionally silenced state. The review further details how HPV escapes immune clearance by driving a Th1-to-Th2 cytokine shift, downregulating MHC class I expression, and recruiting myeloid-derived suppressor cells and regulatory T cells to the cervical microenvironment. Additionally, we discuss the role of cofactors, focusing on the synergistic interaction between estradiol and HPV oncogenes; this interaction promotes local immunosuppression via estrogen receptor alpha signaling on stromal fibroblasts and infiltrating immune cells. We also examine the contribution of high parity as a key epidemiological risk factor. A comparative analysis of patient data across three distinct studies is presented to illustrate how demographic and reproductive variables correlate with cervical lesion severity in different populations. Ultimately, cervical carcinogenesis stems from multi-pathway interactions where viral oncogenes, epigenetic changes, immune escape, and hormonal factor

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) as the primary etiological driver of cervical cancer, focusing on the central question of how HR-HPV disrupts host regulatory mechanisms to drive malignant transformation. The scope explicitly targets HR-HPV types (e.g., HPV16, HPV18) and their associated cervical carcinogenesis, excluding non-target papillomaviruses and non-HPV contexts.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review that synthesizes mechanisms by which HR-HPV oncoproteins (E6, E7) alter host epigenetic regulation, immune evasion, and hormonal cofactor interactions. The review does not report systematic search methods, eligibility criteria, or included-study counts, nor does it perform meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that HR-HPV oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host DNA methyltransferases (DNMT1, DNMT3A, DNMT3B) to silence tumor suppressor genes (e.g., CCNA, hTERT, E-cadherin) via promoter hypermethylation. Additionally, HPV disrupts histone modification patterns through interactions with p300/CBP, NuRD, and Polycomb group proteins, while driving immune escape via Th1-to-Th2 cytokine shifts, MHC class I downregulation, and recruitment of myeloid-derived suppressor cells and regulatory T cells.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights heterogeneity in demographic and reproductive risk factors (e.g., high parity) across populations but does not resolve conflicting findings or weak methods. It also lacks comparative data on lesion severity across diverse populations beyond a cursory mention of three studies, leaving unresolved questions about the relative contributions of cofactors like estradiol and parity in cervical carcinogenesis.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review implies that targeting HPV-driven epigenetic modifications (e.g., DNMT inhibition) and immune evasion pathways (e.g., MHC class I upregulation) could inform therapeutic strategies. It also suggests prioritizing research on hormonal cofactor interactions (e.g., estrogen receptor alpha signaling) and epidemiological risk stratification to improve cervical cancer prevention and early detection.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores how high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) drives cervical cancer by disrupting host regulatory mechanisms. It identifies three key pathways: epigenetic silencing of tumor suppressors via DNA methylation and histone modifications, immune evasion through cytokine shifts and MHC class I downregulation, and hormonal cofactor interactions, particularly estradiol-mediated immunosuppression. The review synthesizes evidence that HR-HPV oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host enzymes to silence genes like CCNA, hTERT, and E-cadherin, while also altering histone acetylation and methylation. It further details HPV’s evasion of immune clearance by recruiting suppressor cells and shifting cytokine profiles. The review highlights demographic risk factors such as high parity but lacks systematic comparative data. It concludes by emphasizing the need for targeted research into epigenetic therapies, immune modulation, and hormonal interactions to improve cervical cancer prevention and treatment.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 视为 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素,重点关注 HR-HPV 如何破坏 宿主 监管机制以驱动恶性转化的核心问题。该范围明确针对 HR-HPV 类型(例如 HPV16、HPV18)及其相关的宫颈癌发生,不包括非目标乳头瘤病毒和非 HPV 环境。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,综合了 HR-HPV 癌蛋白(E6、E7)改变 宿主 表观遗传调节、免疫逃避和激素辅助因子相互作用的机制。该综述不报告系统检索方法、资格标准或纳入研究计数,也不进行荟萃分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,HR-HPV 癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 招募 宿主 DNA 甲基转移酶(DNMT1、DNMT3A、DNMT3B)通过启动子高甲基化来沉默肿瘤抑制基因(例如 CCNA、hTERT、E-钙粘蛋白)。此外,HPV 通过与 p300/CBP、NuRD 和 Polycomb 族蛋白的相互作用破坏组蛋白修饰模式,同时通过 Th1 到 Th2 细胞因子转变、MHC I 类下调以及骨髓源性抑制细胞和调节性 T 细胞的募集来驱动免疫逃逸。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了不同人群之间人口和生殖风险因素(例如高胎次)的异质性,但没有解决相互矛盾的发现或薄弱的方法。除了粗略提及三项研究之外,它还缺乏不同人群病变严重程度的比较数据,从而留下了关于雌二醇和胎次等辅助因子在宫颈癌发生中的相对贡献的未解决的问题。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,针对 HPV 驱动的表观遗传修饰(例如 DNMT 抑制)和免疫逃避途径(例如 MHC I 类上调)可以为治疗策略提供信息。它还建议优先研究激素辅助因子相互作用(例如雌激素受体α信号传导)和流行病学风险分层,以改善 宫颈癌 的预防和早期检测。

It also suggests prioritizing research on hormonal cofactor interactions (e.g., estrogen receptor alpha signaling) and epidemiological risk stratification to improve cervical cancer prevention and early detection.

title_zh: 高危型HPV 菌株在 宫颈癌 中诱导的表观遗传修饰和 宿主 基因沉默特征
source_body_en: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary driver of cervical cancer; however, viral presence alone is insufficient to induce malignancy. The progression from initial infection to invasive carcinoma requires a coordinated series of alterations in both the viral genome and the host cell's regulatory machinery. This review focuses on three principal mechanisms by which HR-HPV bypasses host regulatory controls: epigenetic modifications, immune evasion, and endocrine signaling. Specifically, we describe how the viral oncoproteins E6 and E7 recruit host DNA methyltransferases—particularly DNMT1, DNMT3A, and DNMT3B—to silence tumor suppressor genes such as CCNA, hTERT, and E-cadherin via promoter hypermethylation. Beyond DNA methylation, HPV disrupts histone acetylation and methylation patterns through interactions with p300/CBP, the NuRD complex, and Polycomb group proteins, while simultaneously dysregulating non-coding RNAs and specific microRNAs to reinforce this transcriptionally silenced state. The review further details how HPV escapes immune clearance by driving a Th1-to-Th2 cytokine shift, downregulating MHC class I expression, and recruiting myeloid-derived suppressor cells and regulatory T cells to the cervical microenvironment. Additionally, we discuss the role of cofactors, focusing on the synergistic interaction between estradiol and HPV oncogenes; this interaction promotes local immunosuppression via estrogen receptor alpha signaling on stromal fibroblasts and infiltrating immune cells. We also examine the contribution of high parity as a key epidemiological risk factor. A comparative analysis of patient data across three distinct studies is presented to illustrate how demographic and reproductive variables correlate with cervical lesion severity in different populations. Ultimately, cervical carcinogenesis stems from multi-pathway interactions where viral oncogenes, epigenetic changes, immune escape, and hormonal factor

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述将高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 视为 宫颈癌 的主要病因驱动因素,重点关注 HR-HPV 如何破坏 宿主 监管机制以驱动恶性转化的核心问题。该范围明确针对 HR-HPV 类型(例如 HPV16、HPV18)及其相关的宫颈癌发生,不包括非目标乳头瘤病毒和非 HPV 环境。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一篇叙述性综述,综合了 HR-HPV 癌蛋白(E6、E7)改变 宿主 表观遗传调节、免疫逃避和激素辅助因子相互作用的机制。该综述不报告系统检索方法、资格标准或纳入研究计数,也不进行荟萃分析或共识过程。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,HR-HPV 癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 招募 宿主 DNA 甲基转移酶(DNMT1、DNMT3A、DNMT3B)通过启动子高甲基化来沉默肿瘤抑制基因(例如 CCNA、hTERT、E-钙粘蛋白)。此外,HPV 通过与 p300/CBP、NuRD 和 Polycomb 族蛋白的相互作用破坏组蛋白修饰模式,同时通过 Th1 到 Th2 细胞因子转变、MHC I 类下调以及骨髓源性抑制细胞和调节性 T 细胞的募集来驱动免疫逃逸。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了不同人群之间人口和生殖风险因素(例如高胎次)的异质性,但没有解决相互矛盾的发现或薄弱的方法。除了粗略提及三项研究之外,它还缺乏不同人群病变严重程度的比较数据,从而留下了关于雌二醇和胎次等辅助因子在宫颈癌发生中的相对贡献的未解决的问题。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,针对 HPV 驱动的表观遗传修饰(例如 DNMT 抑制)和免疫逃避途径(例如 MHC I 类上调)可以为治疗策略提供信息。它还建议优先研究激素辅助因子相互作用(例如雌激素受体α信号传导)和流行病学风险分层,以改善 宫颈癌 的预防和早期检测。

title: Adverse Effects of Treatments for Anogenital Warts in Non-immunocompromised Adults: A Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstract: INTRODUCTION: International guidelines for the management of anogenital warts (AGWs) propose multiple first-line options but do not prioritize treatments based on safety or tolerability. This study aimed to compare the safety profiles of topical, systemic, and ablative treatments used for external AGWs in immunocompetent adults. METHODS: A systematic review and frequentist network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials published through August 2025 was performed. Adverse events (AEs) were classified as low-, moderate-, or high-grade local AEs (LGL, MGL, HGL) and low-grade general AEs (LGG). Relative risks were estimated using random-effects models with placebo as the reference. RESULTS: We included 107 RCTs involving 12,423 participants. Ablative procedures were associated with higher rates of moderate-to-severe local AEs compared with topical therapies. Among topical treatments, imiquimod 5% and cidofovir cream were associated with lower rates of severe AEs, whereas podophyllotoxin was more often associated with LGL. SUCRA rankings placed topical treatments above ablative therapies in terms of tolerability. Cidofovir cream demonstrated the best safety profile, followed by imiquimod 5%. CONCLUSION: This network meta-analysis highlights significant differences in tolerability across AGW treatments and offers a comparative framework for patient-centered therapeutic decision-making. It also emphasizes the need for standardized AE reporting in future trials.

abstract_zh: 简介:国际肛门生殖器疣 (AGW) 治疗指南提出了多种一线选择,但并未根据安全性或耐受性优先考虑 治疗。本研究旨在比较免疫功能正常的成人中用于外部 AGW 的局部、全身和消融 治疗 的安全性。方法:对截至 2025 年 8 月发表的随机对照试验进行系统评价和频率网络荟萃分析。不良事件 (AE) 分为低级、中级或高级局部 AE(LGL、MGL、HGL)和低级一般 AE(LGG)。使用随机效应模型以安慰剂作为参考来估计相对风险。结果:我们纳入了 107 项随机对照试验,涉及 12,423 名参与者。与局部治疗相比,消融手术与中度至重度局部 AE 发生率较高相关。在外用 治疗 中,5% 咪喹莫特和西多福韦乳膏与较低的严重 AE 发生率相关,而鬼臼毒素则更常与 LGL 相关。SUCRA 排名将局部 治疗 的耐受性置于消融疗法之上。西多福韦乳膏的安全性最好,其次是 5% 咪喹莫特。结论:该网络荟萃分析强调了 AGW 治疗 耐受性的显着差异,并为以患者为中心的治疗决策提供了比较框架。它还强调了未来试验中标准化 AE 报告的必要性。

title: Prevalence of human papillomavirus in the public health system of the central-northern region of Chile.
abstract: OBJECTIVE Previously, we found a high prevalence of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the private health system. Therefore, the objective of this study was to determine the frequency of HR-HPV in a large cohort of women attending the public health system and to compare these findings. METHODS A total of 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 were analyzed using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique. RESULTS The overall prevalence of HR-HPV infection between 2020 and 2024 was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with annual values of 13.07%, 12.64%, 14.80%, 14.24%, and 14.15% in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. In women under 25 years of age, the prevalence of HR-HPV was 34.03% during the evaluated period, compared to 16.35% in women aged 25 to 44 years, 10.47% in those aged 45 to 64 years, and 11.52% in women over 64 years of age. Pap smears showed 89.71% NILM results in HPV-negative women, compared to 74.59% in HPV-positive women. The rates of LSIL and HSIL were 0.14% and 0.07% in HPV-negative women, respectively; however, these values increased to 4.73% and 4.43% in HPV-positive women, respectively. Probable carcinoma was found in only 0.006% of HPV-negative women, but in 0.46% of HPV-positive women. CONCLUSIONS The prevalence of HR-HPV infection in women attending the public health system in the central-northern region appears to be similar to that previously reported in Chile, but lower than that reported in the same region for women attending the private health system.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine the frequency of high-risk HPV (HR-HPV) in women attending the public health system, comparing these findings to previously reported data from the private health system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cohort study analyzed 39,512 cervical samples from women aged 18 to 91 years who attended gynecological check-ups between 2020 and 2024 in the central-northern region of Chile.
analysis.methods: Samples were tested using qPCR and the Papanicolaou technique to detect HR-HPV infection and cytological abnormalities.
analysis.main_results: The overall HR-HPV prevalence was 13.70% (95% CI: 13.37-14.05%), with higher rates in women under 25 years (34.03%) compared to older age groups. HPV-positive women showed increased rates of LSIL (4.73% vs. 0.14%) and HSIL (4.43% vs. 0.07%) compared to HPV-negative women.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that HR-HPV prevalence in the public health system was similar to previous national reports but lower than in the private health system, highlighting potential disparities in HPV infection rates across healthcare sectors.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings inform targeted HPV screening strategies, particularly for younger women, and support public health interventions to reduce HPV-related diseases in underserved populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's strength lies in its large sample size and longitudinal design, but limitations include potential selection bias from single-region data and reliance on self-reported healthcare attendance.

title: Phased amplicon multiplex sequencing for cost-effective detection of high-risk human papillomavirus from cervical samples
abstract: Access to accurate cost-effective technologies for typing high-risk human papillomaviruses (hrHPV) is critical to expand cervical cancer screening and inform vaccination strategies. Compared with clinical-standard quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) assays, HPV genotyping by next-generation sequencing (NGS) provides greater flexibility, scalability, and genotype specificity. We have developed a method for HPV genotyping, HPV Phased Amplicon Multiplex Sequencing (PhAM-Seq), that uses combinatorial barcoding of amplicons with short, variable-length inline sequences to enable higher throughput and lower per-sample costs than conventional amplicon sequencing approaches. We evaluated HPV PhAM-Seq using degenerate and type-specific primers targeting the L1 and E6-E7 gene loci in a blinded cohort of 170 cervical samples previously typed by the Seegene Anyplex II HPV28 Detection qPCR assay. Across eight common hrHPV types (HPV16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 45, 52, and 58), HPV PhAM-Seq demonstrated >80% overall agreement with qPCR using degenerate L1-targeting primers, with the highest sensitivity for HPV16, 31, 33, and 58. Sensitivity for HPV35, 45, and 52 improved to 85% or greater with type-specific primers targeting genes E6/E7. Parallel processing and sequencing enables a single technician to assay hundreds of samples per week at a reagent cost of around $10 USD per sample, with laboratory automation and sequencing on higher-output platforms enabling further scaling and cost reduction to a scale amenable to population-level surveillance. We include a detailed SOP; tools for primer design, sequencing library construction, and sample tracking; and all scripts needed for data analysis to ensure HPV PhAM-Seq can be readily implemented for scalable, cost-effective hrHPV genotyping or extended to other similar applications.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop and evaluate a cost-effective method for detecting high-risk human papillomaviruses (hrHPV) to improve cervical cancer screening and vaccination strategies.

analysis.methods: The method, HPV Phased Amplicon Multiplex Sequencing (PhAM-Seq), uses combinatorial barcoding of amplicons with short, variable-length inline sequences to enable higher throughput and lower per-sample costs than conventional amplicon sequencing approaches. Parallel processing and sequencing allow a single technician to assay hundreds of samples per week at a reagent cost of around $10 USD per sample.
analysis.main_results: Across eight common hrHPV types (HPV16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 45, 52, and 58), HPV PhAM-Seq demonstrated >80% overall agreement with qPCR using degenerate L1-targeting primers, with the highest sensitivity for HPV16, 31, 33, and 58.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the method provides a scalable and cost-effective alternative to conventional qPCR for hrHPV genotyping, with improved sensitivity for certain types when using type-specific primers.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces HPV Phased Amplicon Multiplex Sequencing (PhAM-Seq) as a cost-effective and scalable method for detecting high-risk human papillomaviruses (hrHPV) in cervical samples. The method uses combinatorial barcoding to enable higher throughput and lower per-sample costs compared to conventional sequencing approaches. Evaluated against the Seegene Anyplex II HPV28 Detection qPCR assay on a blinded cohort of 170 cervical samples, PhAM-Seq showed >80% overall agreement with qPCR using degenerate L1-targeting primers, with the highest sensitivity for HPV16, 31, 33, and 58. Sensitivity for HPV35, 45, and 52 improved to 85% or greater with type-specific primers targeting the E6/E7 gene loci. The authors interpret that PhAM-Seq offers a promising alternative for population-level surveillance and could enhance cervical cancer screening and vaccination strategies. However, the study is limited to a single methodological approach and a blinded cohort, which may affect its generalisability.

title: Cervical Cancer Screening With Human Papillomavirus Self-Collection Testing in an Opioid Treatment Program
abstract: Importance: Individuals with opioid use disorder and substance use disorder have lower cervical cancer screening rates than the general population. Human papillomavirus (HPV) self-collection testing provides opportunities to expand screening access to previously unreached patient populations. Objectives: To assess the feasibility and uptake of incorporating HPV self-collection testing for cervical cancer screening into routine care for patients with opioid use disorder and substance use disorder, and to track the rates of high-risk HPV and guideline concordant follow-up care in this population. Design, Setting, and Participants: This prospective cohort study was conducted from June 24, 2024, through December 31, 2025, at We Care Daily Clinics, a federally certified opioid treatment program (OTP) and American Indian Health Facility in Auburn, Washington. Eligible patients were 25 years or older, had a cervix, and were either overdue for cervical cancer screening or unsure of their last screening. Intervention: Screening using self-collection kits was offered during the patient's annual wellness visit, and self-collection occurred privately in the clinic restroom. Samples were analyzed for 14 high-risk HPV types at a laboratory. Screened patients with HPV-positive results received education and recommendations for guideline-concordant care. OTP staff facilitated patient referrals to local clinicians for gynecologic services, and follow-up was tracked. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcomes were the rates of HPV self-collection testing uptake, HPV positivity, and successful linkage to follow-up care. Results: A total of 194 patients (median [range] age, 41 [25-65] years) were evaluated. Of 174 patients (89.7%) eligible for cervical cancer screening, 158 (90.8%) completed HPV self-collection testing. There were 0 unsatisfactory test results, and 128 patients (81.0%) had HPV-negative results, 7 (4.4%) had HPV-16- or HPV-18-positive results, and 23 (14.6%) had positive results for other high-risk HPV types (non-HPV-16 or HPV-18 types only). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 患有阿片类药物使用障碍和物质使用障碍的个体的 宫颈癌 筛查率低于一般人群,而 HPV 自我收集检测为将筛查范围扩大到以前未覆盖的患者群体提供了机会。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究于 2024 年 6 月 24 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日在 We Care Daily Clinics、联邦认证的阿片类药物 治疗 计划和华盛顿州奥本的美洲印第安人健康设施进行,符合条件的患者为 25 岁或以上、有宫颈、逾期进行 宫颈癌 筛查或不确定是否上次筛查。
elements_zh.methods: 在患者每年的健康访问期间,使用自我收集套件进行筛查,并在诊所卫生间私下进行自我收集;在实验室对样本进行了 14 种 高危型HPV 类型分析,HPV 阳性患者接受了教育并获得了符合指南的护理建议。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共对 194 名患者进行了评估,174 名符合条件的患者中有 158 名(90.8%)完成了 HPV 自采集检测;检测结果不理想的有 0 例,其中 128 例(81.0%)HPV 阴性,7 例(4.4%)HPV-16 或 HPV-18 阳性,23 例(14.6%)其他 高危型HPV 类型阳性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,使用 HPV 自我收集检测将 宫颈癌 筛查纳入阿片类药物 治疗 计划是可行的,患者资格和采用率较高。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为扩大对阿片类药物使用障碍服务不足人群的 宫颈癌 筛查范围提供了依据,证明了自我收集测试在提高高危人群筛查率方面的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于单中心设置和有限的随访数据,证据强度中等,其局限性包括潜在的普遍性限制和 HPV 阳性患者的随访不完整。

title: HPV16 E7-Associated SERPINB3 Suppression and MYC-Related Epithelial Plasticity in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection defines a distinct subtype of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Although HPV-positive (HPV+) HNSCC generally shows better overall survival than HPV-negative (HPV−) disease, it is frequently associated with cervical lymph node metastasis. However, the epithelial cell states and viral gene-associated mechanisms underlying HPV−related metastatic progression remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify metastasis-associated epithelial subpopulations in HPV+ HNSCC and explore the potential role of HPV16 E7 in regulating metastatic programs. Methods: Public single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets from paired primary and metastatic HNSCC samples were integrated and analyzed to characterize malignant epithelial subpopulations. Copy number variation (CNV) inference, clustering, pathway enrichment, stemness scoring, and trajectory analysis were performed to define metastasis-associated epithelial states. TCGA transcriptomic data and tissue-based validation were used to support candidate gene screening. In vitro functional assays were performed using SERPINB3-knockdown and HPV16 early gene-overexpressing CAL27 cell models. Results: Single-cell analysis identified stem-like metastatic epithelial subpopulations in HPV+ and HPV− HNSCC. In HPV+ metastatic lesions, an ALDH2+/LAMB3+ epithelial subpopulation showed elevated epithelial–mesenchymal transition activity and stem-like features. SERPINB3 displayed a dynamic expression pattern during HPV+ metastatic progression. Functional assays showed that SERPINB3 knockdown enhanced CAL27 cell migration and invasion and was associated with activation of MYC- and epithelial–mesenchymal transition-related transcriptional programs. Among HPV16 early genes, E5, E6, E6*, and E7 showed different degrees of SERPINB3 suppression, while E7-expressing cells exhibited distinct transcriptional alterations associated with epithelial plasticity and metastatic-related programs. Conclusions: This study identifies a stem-like metastatic epithelial state in HPV-associated HNSCC and suggests a potential HPV16 early gene-SERPINB3-MYC-related regulatory mechanism involved in metastatic epithelial plasticity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates HPV-associated head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), focusing on metastasis mechanisms. By analyzing single-cell RNA-sequencing data from primary and metastatic samples, the researchers identified stem-like epithelial subpopulations in HPV+ HNSCC, particularly an ALDH2+/LAMB3+ subpopulation with enhanced metastatic potential. Functional assays revealed that SERPINB3 knockdown promotes cell migration and invasion via MYC and epithelial-mesenchymal transition pathways, while HPV16 E7 suppresses SERPINB3, influencing epithelial plasticity. The findings suggest a novel HPV16 E7-SERPINB3-MYC regulatory axis in metastatic progression, offering potential targets for therapy.

title_zh: 头颈鳞状细胞癌中 HPV16 E7 相关的 SERPINB3 抑制和 MYC 相关上皮可塑性
source_body_en: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection defines a distinct subtype of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Although HPV-positive (HPV+) HNSCC generally shows better overall survival than HPV-negative (HPV−) disease, it is frequently associated with cervical lymph node metastasis. However, the epithelial cell states and viral gene-associated mechanisms underlying HPV−related metastatic progression remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify metastasis-associated epithelial subpopulations in HPV+ HNSCC and explore the potential role of HPV16 E7 in regulating metastatic programs. Methods: Public single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets from paired primary and metastatic HNSCC samples were integrated and analyzed to characterize malignant epithelial subpopulations. Copy number variation (CNV) inference, clustering, pathway enrichment, stemness scoring, and trajectory analysis were performed to define metastasis-associated epithelial states. TCGA transcriptomic data and tissue-based validation were used to support candidate gene screening. In vitro functional assays were performed using SERPINB3-knockdown and HPV16 early gene-overexpressing CAL27 cell models. Results: Single-cell analysis identified stem-like metastatic epithelial subpopulations in HPV+ and HPV− HNSCC. In HPV+ metastatic lesions, an ALDH2+/LAMB3+ epithelial subpopulation showed elevated epithelial–mesenchymal transition activity and stem-like features. SERPINB3 displayed a dynamic expression pattern during HPV+ metastatic progression. Functional assays showed that SERPINB3 knockdown enhanced CAL27 cell migration and invasion and was associated with activation of MYC- and epithelial–mesenchymal transition-related transcriptional programs. Among HPV16 early genes, E5, E6, E6*, and E7 showed different degrees of SERPINB3 suppression, while E7-expressing cells exhibited distinct transcriptional alterations associated with epithelial plasticity and metastatic-related programs. Conclusions: This study identifies a stem-like metastatic epithelial state in HPV-associated HNSCC and suggests a potential HPV16 early gene-SERPINB3-MYC-related regulatory mechanism involved in metastatic epithelial plasticity.
abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染定义了头颈鳞状细胞癌 (HNSCC) 的一种独特亚型。尽管 HPV 阳性 (HPV+) HNSCC 通常比 HPV 阴性 (HPV−) 疾病表现出更好的总体生存率,但它经常与颈部淋巴结转移相关。然而,HPV 相关转移进展的上皮细胞状态和病毒基因相关机制仍不完全清楚。本研究旨在鉴定 HPV+ HNSCC 中与转移相关的上皮亚群,并探讨 HPV16 E7 在调节转移程序中的潜在作用。方法:对来自配对的原发性和转移性 HNSCC 样本的公共单细胞 RNA 测序数据集进行整合和分析,以表征恶性上皮亚群。进行拷贝数变异(CNV)推断、聚类、通路富集、干性评分和轨迹分析来定义转移相关的上皮状态。TCGA 转录组数据和基于组织的验证用于支持候选基因筛选。使用 SERPINB3 敲低和 HPV16 早期基因过表达 CAL27 细胞模型进行体外功能测定。结果:单细胞分析鉴定出 HPV+ 和 HPV− HNSCC 中的干细胞样转移上皮亚群。在 HPV+ 转移性病变中,ALDH2+/LAMB3+ 上皮亚群表现出上皮-间质转化活性升高和干细胞样特征。SERPINB3 在 HPV+ 转移进展过程中表现出动态表达模式。功能分析表明,SERPINB3 敲除增强了 CAL27 细胞迁移和侵袭,并与 MYC 和上皮间质转化相关转录程序的激活相关。在HPV16早期基因中,E5、E6、E6*和E7表现出不同程度的SERPINB3抑制,而表达E7的细胞表现出与上皮可塑性和转移相关程序相关的明显转录改变。结论:本研究鉴定了 HPV 相关 HNSCC 中的干细胞样转移上皮状态,并提出了参与转移上皮可塑性的潜在 HPV16 早期基因 -SERPINB3-MYC 相关调节机制。

title: HPV18 DNA detection and pathological laryngopharyngeal reflux in a young woman with glottic squamous cell carcinoma in situ: a brief report
abstract: Laryngeal cancer predominantly affects elderly males with long-term smoking and alcohol histories, and its occurrence in young females is extremely rare. We report a 26-year-old woman with glottic squamous cell carcinoma in situ who presented with persistent hoarseness. She had no history of smoking, alcohol use, or radiation exposure. Upon evaluation, high-risk HPV18 DNA was detected in FFPE tumor tissue by Lcn PCR, and 24-hour MII-pH monitoring indicated pathological laryngopharyngeal reflux. Targeted sequencing of 535 genes showed no driver mutations, tumor mutation burden elevation, or microsatellite instability. The patient underwent transoral laser resection followed by postoperative anti-reflux management. At follow-up, she remained recurrence-free. This case suggests a possible contribution of HPV18 and laryngopharyngeal reflux to carcinogenesis in a young non-smoking woman with glottic carcinoma in situ. The findings support selective virologic evaluation and individualized reflux assessment in clinically atypical laryngeal squamous lesions.

analysis_zh.methods: 使用 Lcn PCR 在福尔马林固定石蜡包埋的肿瘤组织中检测到高危 HPV18 DNA,并通过 24 小时多通道腔内阻抗 pH 监测确定病理性咽喉反流。对 535 个基因进行靶向测序,评估驱动 突变、肿瘤 突变 负荷和微卫星不稳定性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在肿瘤组织中检测到HPV18 DNA,证实病理性咽喉反流,靶向测序显示无驱动突变、肿瘤突变负荷升高或微卫星不稳定。随访时患者未复发。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 HPV18 的检测和病理反流解释为这种非典型病例中致癌的可能因素,并指出不存在常规危险因素和基因组改变。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持对临床非典型喉鳞状病变,特别是年轻不吸烟女性进行选择性病毒学评估和个体化反流评估。

analysis.summary_en: This multicenter cross-sectional survey assessed HPV knowledge and attitudes among health professionals in Hunan Province. Using convenience sampling, 2,777 valid responses were collected from professionals across 14 cities. title: Three-year persistence and clearance patterns of high-risk HPV genotype groups among women in Chirchik, Uzbekistan: A pilot longitudinal study
abstract: Abstract Background High-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) persistence is central to cervical carcinogenesis, yet longitudinal data from Central Asia remain limited. This pilot longitudinal study assessed the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns among women in Chirchik, Uzbekistan. Methods From August 2021 to March 2022, 5,678 women were screened for hrHPV, of whom 547 (9.6%) tested positive. HPV genotyping was performed using the Xpert HPV assay. Single infections were defined as the detection of one genotype group, while multiple infections were defined as the detection of two or more groups. Clearance was defined as a negative HPV test at 3-year follow-up. Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank tests, and Cox regression were used for analysis. Results Single infections predominated at baseline (87.0%, 476/547), while double, triple, and quadruple infections accounted for 11.2%, 1.5%, and 0.2% of cases, respectively. The most frequently detected genotype groups were HPV16 (29.8%), HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.9%), and HPV39/56/66/68 (16.5%). At 3-year follow-up, 409 baseline hrHPV-positive women were re-evaluated, and 108 remained hrHPV-positive. Single infections remained predominant among persistent hrHPV-positive cases (94.4%, 102/108). HPV16 was the most frequently detected genotype group at follow-up (38.0%), followed by HPV39/56/66/68 (24.1%) and HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.4%). Newly detected genotype groups were observed in 36 women, with HPV39/56/66/68 being the most common (52.8%). Clearance rates were numerically higher in selected HPV16 -containing co-infection groups than in single HPV16 infection, but no statistically significant difference was observed (log-rank p = 0.528). Conclusion This pilot study provides preliminary longitudinal evidence on the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns in Uzbekistan. Larger studies with repeated follow-up testing and genotype-level analysis are needed to confirm these findings.
