title_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦奇尔奇克妇女中 高危型HPV 基因型组的三年持续性和清除模式:一项试点纵向研究
source_body_en: Abstract Background High-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) persistence is central to cervical carcinogenesis, yet longitudinal data from Central Asia remain limited. This pilot longitudinal study assessed the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns among women in Chirchik, Uzbekistan. Methods From August 2021 to March 2022, 5,678 women were screened for hrHPV, of whom 547 (9.6%) tested positive. HPV genotyping was performed using the Xpert HPV assay. Single infections were defined as the detection of one genotype group, while multiple infections were defined as the detection of two or more groups. Clearance was defined as a negative HPV test at 3-year follow-up. Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank tests, and Cox regression were used for analysis. Results Single infections predominated at baseline (87.0%, 476/547), while double, triple, and quadruple infections accounted for 11.2%, 1.5%, and 0.2% of cases, respectively. The most frequently detected genotype groups were HPV16 (29.8%), HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.9%), and HPV39/56/66/68 (16.5%). At 3-year follow-up, 409 baseline hrHPV-positive women were re-evaluated, and 108 remained hrHPV-positive. Single infections remained predominant among persistent hrHPV-positive cases (94.4%, 102/108). HPV16 was the most frequently detected genotype group at follow-up (38.0%), followed by HPV39/56/66/68 (24.1%) and HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.4%). Newly detected genotype groups were observed in 36 women, with HPV39/56/66/68 being the most common (52.8%). Clearance rates were numerically higher in selected HPV16 -containing co-infection groups than in single HPV16 infection, but no statistically significant difference was observed (log-rank p = 0.528). Conclusion This pilot study provides preliminary longitudinal evidence on the distribution of hrHPV genotype groups and 3-year follow-up patterns in Uzbekistan. Larger studies with repeated follow-up testing and genotype-level analysis are needed to confirm these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (hrHPV) 的持续存在是宫颈癌发生的核心,但来自中亚的纵向数据仍然有限。这项纵向试点研究评估了乌兹别克斯坦奇尔奇克女性中 hrHPV 基因型组的分布和 3 年随访模式。方法 2021年8月至2022年3月,对5,678名女性进行了hrHPV筛查,其中547名(9.6%)检测结果呈阳性。使用 Xpert HPV 检测进行 HPV 基因分型。单次感染定义为检测到一个基因型组,而多重感染定义为检测到两个或多个基因型组。清除被定义为 3 年随访时 HPV 检测呈阴性。使用 Kaplan-Meier 曲线、对数秩检验和 Cox 回归进行分析。结果 基线时单一感染占主导地位(87.0%、476/547),而双重、三重和四重感染分别占病例的 11.2%、1.5% 和 0.2%。最常检测到的基因型组是 HPV16 (29.8%)、HPV31/33/35/52/58 (19.9%) 和 HPV39/56/66/68 (16.5%)。在 3 年随访中,409 名基线 hrHPV 阳性女性接受了重新评估,其中 108 名仍为 hrHPV 阳性。在持续性 hrHPV 阳性病例中,单一感染仍然占主导地位(94.4%,102/108)。HPV16是随访时最常检测到的基因型组(38.0%),其次是HPV39/56/66/68(24.1%)和HPV31/33/35/52/58(19.4%)。在 36 名女性中观察到新检测到的基因型组,其中 HPV39/56/66/68 最常见(52.8%)。选定的 HPV16 合并感染组的清除率在数值上高于单一 HPV16 感染组,但未观察到统计学上的显着差异(对数秩 p = 0.528)。结论 这项试点研究为乌兹别克斯坦 hrHPV 基因型组的分布和 3 年随访模式提供了初步纵向证据。需要进行更大规模的研究,包括重复的后续测试和基因型水平分析来证实这些发现。

title: Evaluation and comparison of large language model responses to patient questions after diagnosis of high-risk human papillomavirus infection: an expert-rated digital patient education study
abstract: Background After diagnosis of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, patients often seek guidance on cancer risk, colposcopy, follow-up, treatment, partner management, pregnancy, and anxiety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical consultation, but their response quality and safety in this setting require evaluation. Methods In this single-center, expert-rated methodological study, 15 patient-style questions based on common outpatient consultations were submitted to ChatGPT-5.5 Instant and DeepSeek-V3. Each model generated three independent responses per question, yielding 90 artificial intelligence (AI)-generated responses. Five blinded gynecology experts independently evaluated all responses, producing 450 expert-rating records. Accuracy, safety, guideline concordance, completeness, and understandability were rated on a 1–5 Likert scale. Experts also assessed major error and potential harm. The primary outcome was the proportion of responses without major error or potential harm. Results ChatGPT-5.5 Instant had higher response-level scores than DeepSeek-V3 for accuracy (mean difference, 0.25; 95% CI, 0.11–0.39; FDR-adjusted p = 0.010), safety (0.27; 0.07–0.47; p = 0.010), completeness (0.22; 0.07–0.37; p = 0.020), and composite score (0.18; 0.04–0.31; p = 0.027). The difference in guideline concordance did not remain significant after multiplicity correction (0.16; −0.01 to 0.33; FDR-adjusted p = 0.057), and understandability was similar. Responses without major error or potential harm occurred in 42/45 (93.3%; 95% CI, 81.7–98.6%) ChatGPT responses and 38/45 (84.4%; 70.5–93.5%) DeepSeek-V3 responses (risk difference, 8.9 percentage points; 95% CI, −13.3 to 31.1; p = 0.344). Exploratory question-level risks were observed in HPV16/18 positivity, normal cytology, partner management, and pregnancy scenarios. Conclusion Both two models demonstrated generally strong performance across the evaluated quality domains. ChatGPT achieved higher ratings in several quality domains, but response-level binary safety differences were imprecise and not statistically significant. Both models require guideline-based clinical oversight.

analysis.research_question_and_background: After a diagnosis of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, patients frequently seek guidance on cancer risk, follow-up, treatment, partner management, pregnancy, and anxiety, highlighting a need for reliable digital patient education resources.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This single-center, expert-rated methodological study submitted 15 patient-style questions to two large language models (LLMs), generating 90 AI-generated responses evaluated by five blinded gynecology experts, producing 450 expert-rating records.
analysis.methods: Fifteen patient-style questions based on common outpatient consultations were submitted to ChatGPT-5.5 Instant and DeepSeek-V3, each generating three independent responses per question. Five blinded gynecology experts independently evaluated all responses on accuracy, safety, guideline concordance, completeness, and understandability using a 1–5 Likert scale, and assessed major error and potential harm.
analysis.main_results: ChatGPT-5.5 Instant had higher response-level scores than DeepSeek-V3 for accuracy (mean difference, 0.25; 95% CI, 0.11–0.39; FDR-adjusted p = 0.010), safety (0.27; 0.07–0.47; p = 0.010), completeness (0.22; 0.07–0.37; p = 0.020), and composite score (0.18; 0.04–0.31; p = 0.027). Responses without major error or potential harm occurred in 42/45 (93.3%; 95% CI, 81.7–98.6%) ChatGPT responses and 38/45 (84.4%; 70.5–93.5%) DeepSeek-V3 responses (risk difference, 8.9 percentage points; 95% CI, −13.3 to 31.1; p = 0.344).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Both models demonstrated generally strong performance across evaluated quality domains, with ChatGPT achieving higher ratings in several domains, though binary safety differences were imprecise and not statistically significant.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that LLMs can provide high-quality, guideline-concordant responses to patient questions about high-risk HPV infection, but both models require clinical oversight to mitigate potential risks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-center design, reliance on expert ratings rather than patient outcomes, and lack of generalizability beyond the evaluated models and questions, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the quality and safety of responses generated by two large language models (ChatGPT-5.5 Instant and DeepSeek-V3) to 15 patient-style questions about high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection. Five blinded gynecology experts rated 90 AI-generated responses on accuracy, safety, guideline concordance, completeness, and understandability, finding that ChatGPT outperformed DeepSeek in several domains, including accuracy, safety, and completeness. However, differences in binary safety outcomes were not statistically significant, and both models required clinical oversight. The study highlights the potential of LLMs to support patient education while emphasizing the need for caution and expert review.

title_zh: 诊断 高风险 诊断 感染后大语言模型对患者问题的反应的评估和比较:专家评级的数字患者教育研究
source_body_en: Background After diagnosis of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, patients often seek guidance on cancer risk, colposcopy, follow-up, treatment, partner management, pregnancy, and anxiety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical consultation, but their response quality and safety in this setting require evaluation. Methods In this single-center, expert-rated methodological study, 15 patient-style questions based on common outpatient consultations were submitted to ChatGPT-5.5 Instant and DeepSeek-V3. Each model generated three independent responses per question, yielding 90 artificial intelligence (AI)-generated responses. Five blinded gynecology experts independently evaluated all responses, producing 450 expert-rating records. Accuracy, safety, guideline concordance, completeness, and understandability were rated on a 1–5 Likert scale. Experts also assessed major error and potential harm. The primary outcome was the proportion of responses without major error or potential harm. Results ChatGPT-5.5 Instant had higher response-level scores than DeepSeek-V3 for accuracy (mean difference, 0.25; 95% CI, 0.11–0.39; FDR-adjusted p = 0.010), safety (0.27; 0.07–0.47; p = 0.010), completeness (0.22; 0.07–0.37; p = 0.020), and composite score (0.18; 0.04–0.31; p = 0.027). The difference in guideline concordance did not remain significant after multiplicity correction (0.16; −0.01 to 0.33; FDR-adjusted p = 0.057), and understandability was similar. Responses without major error or potential harm occurred in 42/45 (93.3%; 95% CI, 81.7–98.6%) ChatGPT responses and 38/45 (84.4%; 70.5–93.5%) DeepSeek-V3 responses (risk difference, 8.9 percentage points; 95% CI, −13.3 to 31.1; p = 0.344). Exploratory question-level risks were observed in HPV16/18 positivity, normal cytology, partner management, and pregnancy scenarios. Conclusion Both two models demonstrated generally strong performance across the evaluated quality domains. ChatGPT achieved higher ratings in several quality domains, but response-level binary safety differences were imprecise and not statistically significant. Both models require guideline-based clinical oversight.

title: Comparison of cervical swab and urine samples for high-risk HPV infection and PAX1 methylation in detection of cervical neoplasia
abstract: Abstract Cervical cancer screening commonly requires clinician-collected cervical specimens, prompting interest in less invasive sampling approaches. This paired pilot study assessed agreement in high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) detection and PAX1 methylation testing between cervical swab and urine specimens and evaluated their performance for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). We enrolled 104 women with abnormal cervical cytology and histopathological confirmation. Among 94 pairs with valid hrHPV results, overall agreement was 94.7% (Cohen’s κ = 0.883; 95% CI, 0.783–0.983). Among 91 pairs with valid PAX1 results, agreement was 79.1% (κ = 0.446; 95% CI, 0.241–0.651). For CIN3 + detection, cervical swab and urine hrHPV testing showed sensitivities of 86.8% and 80.6% and specificities of 44.4% and 45.9%, respectively. Cervical swab and urine PAX1 methylation showed lower sensitivities of 52.6% and 41.2% but higher specificities of 85.7% and 90.0%, respectively. Rule-based combinations showed sensitivity–specificity trade-offs. In this referral-based cohort, urine hrHPV testing showed high agreement with cervical swab testing, whereas urine PAX1 methylation had lower agreement and sensitivity. Urine-based PAX1 testing remains exploratory and requires optimization and independent validation.

title: Efficacy of live lactobacillus preparations in treating cervical inflammation and clearing viral infections in patients with HPV infection complicated by bacterial vaginosis
abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Dingjunsheng, a live Lactobacillus preparation, as adjuvant therapy in patients with human papillomavirus (HPV) infection complicated by bacterial vaginosis (BV). A retrospective analysis was conducted on 152 eligible patients, randomly divided into two groups: the observation group (n=87) receiving standard BV antibacterial therapy plus Dingjunsheng, and the control group (n=65) who received standard BV antibacterial therapy alone. The patients were followed up for six months. Primary outcomes included HPV clearance rate and cervical cytological inflammation improvement, while secondary outcomes involved BV recurrence rate and adverse reaction incidence. The results showed that the observation group had a significantly higher HPV clearance rate (73.6% vs 53.9%) and inflammation improvement rate (90.8% vs 76.9%), as well as a lower BV recurrence rate (3.1% vs 13.9%) compared to the control group. Dingjunsheng was identified as an independent protective factor for HPV clearance (OR=2.5, 95%CI:1.3–5.1). The incidence of adverse reactions was similar between both groups. We conclude that Dingjunsheng adjuvant therapy demonstrated effectiveness in improving HPV clearance, alleviating inflammation, and reducing BV recurrence, with good safety, making it a valuable treatment strategy for these patients.

title_zh: 活乳酸菌制剂治疗HPV感染并发细菌性阴道病患者宫颈炎症及清除病毒感染的疗效
source_body_en: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Dingjunsheng, a live Lactobacillus preparation, as adjuvant therapy in patients with human papillomavirus (HPV) infection complicated by bacterial vaginosis (BV). A retrospective analysis was conducted on 152 eligible patients, randomly divided into two groups: the observation group (n=87) receiving standard BV antibacterial therapy plus Dingjunsheng, and the control group (n=65) who received standard BV antibacterial therapy alone. The patients were followed up for six months. Primary outcomes included HPV clearance rate and cervical cytological inflammation improvement, while secondary outcomes involved BV recurrence rate and adverse reaction incidence. The results showed that the observation group had a significantly higher HPV clearance rate (73.6% vs 53.9%) and inflammation improvement rate (90.8% vs 76.9%), as well as a lower BV recurrence rate (3.1% vs 13.9%) compared to the control group. Dingjunsheng was identified as an independent protective factor for HPV clearance (OR=2.5, 95%CI:1.3–5.1). The incidence of adverse reactions was similar between both groups. We conclude that Dingjunsheng adjuvant therapy demonstrated effectiveness in improving HPV clearance, alleviating inflammation, and reducing BV recurrence, with good safety, making it a valuable treatment strategy for these patients.

title: HPV vaccination in the WHO South-East Asia Region: A scoping review of uptake, implementation challenges, and pathways to acceleration.
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major public health concern in the WHO South-East Asia Region (SEAR), where human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination coverage remains uneven. This scoping review synthesizes evidence on HPV vaccine uptake and implementation strategies and challenges across SEAR countries. Following the Arksey and O'Malley framework and PRISMA-Scoping Review (ScR) guidelines, 46 studies published between January 2003 and February 2026 were analyzed. Ten of eleven SEAR countries have introduced HPV vaccination nationally, with Bhutan, Sri Lanka, and Thailand achieving coverage above 90%, while several countries remain in early implementation or expansion phases. Four cross-cutting barriers were identified: policy and financial constraints, sociocultural resistance, weak health-system capacity, and vaccine hesitancy. Based on these findings, SEAR-HPV Integrated Implementation Model (SHIM) is proposed to strengthen policy support, sustainable financing, community engagement, workforce preparedness, and digital monitoring. This review highlights evidence-informed strategies to accelerate HPV vaccine scale-up and advance cervical cancer elimination goals in the region.

abstract: BACKGROUND: In Singapore, cervical cancer screening rates remain suboptimal, with only clinician sampling included in the national screening program. Self-sampling human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing might overcome barriers to clinician-based screening and improve uptake. We assessed the effect of offering self-sampling alongside clinician sampling on screening uptake and high-risk HPV detection compared with clinician sampling alone. METHODS: This pragmatic, 2-arm randomized controlled trial with Zelen design was conducted across NHG Polyclinics, NHG Health in Singapore. Women aged 30-69 years due for cervical cancer screening were randomly assigned (1:1) to intervention (offered selection of clinician sampling followed by self-sampling) or usual care (clinician sampling alone). The primary outcome was high-risk HPV DNA detection, and the secondary outcome was screening uptake. We performed subgroup analysis to examine both outcomes by prior screening history. Multivariable analysis identified factors associated with screening choices. RESULTS: From August 2024 to February 2025, 650 women were randomized, and 640 were included in the analysis (320 per arm). Significantly more high-risk HPV was detected in the intervention arm (3.1% vs 0.3%; absolute difference 2.8%; 95% CI, 0.8-4.8;P < .001), driven by greater screening uptake (56.6% vs 42.8%; absolute difference 13.8%; 95% CI, 6.0-21.4; P < .001), particularly among women with regular screening history and those with no prior screening. Among screened participants in the intervention arm, 56.4% chose self-sampling. Lower educational attainment was associated with lower odds of choosing self-sampling over declining screening. CONCLUSIONS: Offering self-sampling HPV DNA testing alongside clinician sampling significantly increased screening uptake and high-risk HPV detection rates. However, uptake remained lower among women with less education, highlighting the need for targeted engagement strategies.Abstract also available in: عربي (Arabic); Deutsch (German); Español (Spanish); Francais (French); हिन्दी (Hindi); Indonesia (Indonesian); (Chinese); (Japanese); Portugues (Portuguese).

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在新加坡,宫颈癌 筛查率仍然不理想,国家筛查计划中仅包括临床医生抽样。自采样 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) DNA 检测可能会克服基于临床医生的筛查的障碍并提高采用率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项采用 Zelen 设计的务实 2 组随机对照试验在新加坡 NHG 综合诊所和 NHG Health 进行。需要进行 宫颈癌 筛查的 30-69 岁女性被随机分配 (1:1) 进行干预(提供临床医生抽样选择,然后自行抽样)或常规护理(仅临床医生抽样)。
elements_zh.methods: 主要结果是 高危型HPV DNA 检测,次要结果是筛选摄取。我们进行了亚组分析,通过先前的筛查历史检查这两种结果,并进行多变量分析,以确定与筛查选择相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: From August 2024 to February 2025, 650 women were randomized, and 640 were included in the analysis (320 per arm). Significantly more high-risk HPV was detected in the intervention arm (3.1% vs 0.3%; absolute difference 2.8%; 95% CI, 0.8-4.8; P < .001), driven by greater screening uptake (56.6% vs 42.8%; absolute difference 13.8%; 95% CI, 6.0-21.4; P < .001), particularly among women with regular screening history and those with no prior screening.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 提供自我采样 HPV DNA 检测和临床医生采样显着提高了筛查率和 高危型HPV 检出率。然而,受教育程度较低的女性的参与度仍然较低,这凸显了制定有针对性的参与战略的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,自我采样 HPV DNA 检测可以提高初级保健机构中 宫颈癌 筛查覆盖率和 高危型HPV 感染的早期发现。这种方法对于接受临床医生筛查的机会有限的女性特别有益。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在单一医疗保健系统中进行的,这可能会限制对其他环境的推广。尽管采用了随机设计,但由于试验的务实性质以及自我抽样选择中可能存在选择偏差,证据强度中等。

title: Esophageal Squamous Papilloma in the Practice of Otolaryngology: A Case Series and Diagnostic Considerations for the otolaryngologist.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Esophageal squamous papilloma (ESP) is a rare, benign, often asymptomatic lesion of the upper aerodigestive tract. While historically managed by gastroenterologists, transnasal esophagoscopy has been incorporated into some otolaryngology practices, expanding the role of the otolaryngologist in diagnosing these lesions. AIMS: To describe a case series of ESP within a tertiary dysphagia center and evaluate the association between human papillomavirus (HPV) and chronic mucosal irritation. METHODS: A retrospective case series was conducted of all individuals diagnosed with ESP at a tertiary center over a 2-year period. Histopathology and DNA in-situ hybridization (ISH) for high and low-risk HPV were reviewed. RESULTS: Five cases were identified. All patients presented with dysphagia or heartburn. ESP was an incidental finding in all cases, co-existing with cricopharyngeal dysfunction, hiatal hernia, or esophagitis. One patient had a history of HPV+ oropharyngeal carcinoma. All lesions were successfully resected endoscopically. ISH was negative for HPV in all specimens. CONCLUSIONS AND SIGNIFICANCE: ESP is a benign entity frequently encountered incidentally during the workup of dysphagia. These results support chronic irritation rather than HPV as the primary etiology. Recognition is vital for otolaryngologists to ensure appropriate resection and surveillance.
journal: Annals of Otology, Rhinology and Laryngology

abstract_zh: 背景:食管鳞状乳头状瘤(ESP)是一种罕见的良性上呼吸消化道病变,通常无症状。虽然历史上由胃肠病学家管理,但经鼻食管镜检查已被纳入一些耳鼻喉科实践中,扩大了耳鼻喉科医师在诊断这些病变中的作用。目的:描述三级吞咽困难中心内的 ESP 病例系列,并评估 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 与慢性粘膜刺激之间的关联。方法:对 2 年时间内在三级中心诊断为 ESP 的所有个体进行回顾性病例系列研究。对高危和低危 HPV 的组织病理学和 DNA 原位杂交 (ISH) 进行了综述。结果:发现 5 例病例。所有患者均出现吞咽困难或胃灼热。所有病例中 ESP 都是偶然发现的,与环咽功能障碍、食管裂孔疝或食管炎并存。一名患者有 HPV+ 口咽癌病史。所有病变均通过内镜成功切除。所有标本中 ISH 的 HPV 均为阴性。结论和意义:ESP 是一种良性实体,经常在吞咽困难检查过程中偶然遇到。这些结果支持慢性刺激而不是 HPV 为主要病因。认可对于耳鼻喉科医生确保适当的切除和 监测 至关重要。

title: Circulating Tumor DNA in Head and Neck Cancer: A Review From the American Head and Neck Society.
abstract: IMPORTANCE: Despite gains in understanding head and neck cancer over the past several decades, the discovery of reliable biomarkers remains elusive. With the advent of human papillomavirus-associated oropharynx cancer and Epstein-Barr virus-associated nasopharynx cancer, circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and oncogenic viral DNA have emerged as potentially promising biomarkers. OBSERVATIONS: A review was conducted by the American Head and Neck Society to address the current utility of ctDNA. Ongoing clinical trials were reviewed, with discussion of its utility in monitoring treatment response and measuring minimal residual disease (MRD). Although ctDNA holds promise in the push for precision oncology, several questions remain regarding its routine clinical use, including test variability and implications of inaccurate test results. Optimized clinical trial designs and further research are necessary to bring ctDNA to the forefront of head and neck cancer management. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Liquid biopsy targeting viral ctDNA is a promising biomarker in the diagnostic and surveillance settings across head and neck cancer types. Ongoing clinical trials will help elucidate how ctDNA can be implemented to monitor treatment response, assess MRD, and frame treatment decisions to adapt treatment via a precision oncology approach.

source_body_en: IMPORTANCE: Despite gains in understanding head and neck cancer over the past several decades, the discovery of reliable biomarkers remains elusive. With the advent of human papillomavirus-associated oropharynx cancer and Epstein-Barr virus-associated nasopharynx cancer, circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and oncogenic viral DNA have emerged as potentially promising biomarkers. Ongoing clinical trials were reviewed, with discussion of its utility in monitoring treatment response and measuring minimal residual disease (MRD). Although ctDNA holds promise in the push for precision oncology, several questions remain regarding its routine clinical use, including test variability and implications of inaccurate test results. Optimized clinical trial designs and further research are necessary to bring ctDNA to the forefront of head and neck cancer management. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Liquid biopsy targeting viral ctDNA is a promising biomarker in the diagnostic and surveillance settings across head and neck cancer types. Ongoing clinical trials will help elucidate how ctDNA can be implemented to monitor treatment response, assess MRD, and frame treatment decisions to adapt treatment via a precision oncology approach.
abstract_zh: 重要性:尽管过去几十年来对头颈癌的了解取得了进展,但可靠的生物标志物的发现仍然难以实现。随着 人乳头瘤病毒 相关口咽癌和 Epstein-Barr 病毒相关鼻咽癌的出现,循环肿瘤 DNA (ctDNA) 和致癌病毒 DNA 已成为潜在有前途的生物标志物。观察结果:美国头颈协会针对 ctDNA 目前的用途进行了审查。回顾了正在进行的临床试验,并讨论了其在监测 治疗 反应和测量微小残留病 (MRD) 方面的效用。尽管 ctDNA 在推动精准肿瘤学方面前景广阔,但其常规临床应用仍存在一些问题,包括测试变异性和不准确测试结果的影响。需要优化临床试验设计和进一步研究,才能将 ctDNA 推向头颈癌治疗的最前沿。结论和相关性:针对病毒 ctDNA 的液体活检是头颈癌诊断和 监测 环境中一种有前途的生物标志物。正在进行的临床试验将有助于阐明如何实施 ctDNA 来监测 治疗 反应、评估 MRD 并制定 治疗 决策,以通过精准肿瘤学方法调整 治疗。

title: Female allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant survivors' perspectives on cervical cancer screening: a retrospective study.
abstract: PURPOSE: Female allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (AlloHCT) survivors are at increased risk for human papillomavirus (HPV)-related malignancies due to immunosuppression. Guidelines recommend annual cervical cancer screening for AlloHCT survivors with a cervix aged 21-65. This study explored cervical cancer screening knowledge, behaviors, attitudes, experiences, and preferences-specifically provider-collected versus self-collected methods-and identified adherence barriers and facilitators. METHODS: We conducted a mixed-methods observational study of female AlloHCT survivors aged 21-65 who received AlloHCT at Oregon Health & Science University between 2012 and 2023. Participants completed demographic surveys and participated in focus groups exploring screening adherence, perceptions, and preferences. RESULTS: Twenty-three survivors completed the survey, and 16 joined focus groups in fall 2024. The median participant age was 49 years (range 32-61); most were white (87%) and privately insured (91%). Median age at bone marrow transplantation (BMT) was 41 years (range 19-56). Primary diagnosis included acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome (65%). Reported complications included graft versus host disease (GVHD) (44%), chronic GVHD (39%), and vaginal GVHD (22%). Awareness of increased cervical cancer risk facilitated screening adherence, while limited access to in-network providers was a barrier. All participants preferred provider-collected screening due to confidence in test accuracy and reassurance from clinician involvement. Psychological factors, particularly worrying about recurrence or secondary cancers, strongly influenced screening preferences. CONCLUSION: Cervical cancer screening preferences among AlloHCT survivors were shaped by physical and psychological treatment-related factors. HPV self-collection may be a supplemental option before BMT, between annual clinic visits, or when access barriers arise.

title_zh: 女性同种异体造血细胞移植幸存者对 宫颈癌 筛查的看法:一项回顾性研究。
source_body_en: PURPOSE: Female allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (AlloHCT) survivors are at increased risk for human papillomavirus (HPV)-related malignancies due to immunosuppression. Guidelines recommend annual cervical cancer screening for AlloHCT survivors with a cervix aged 21-65. This study explored cervical cancer screening knowledge, behaviors, attitudes, experiences, and preferences-specifically provider-collected versus self-collected methods-and identified adherence barriers and facilitators. METHODS: We conducted a mixed-methods observational study of female AlloHCT survivors aged 21-65 who received AlloHCT at Oregon Health & Science University between 2012 and 2023. Participants completed demographic surveys and participated in focus groups exploring screening adherence, perceptions, and preferences. RESULTS: Twenty-three survivors completed the survey, and 16 joined focus groups in fall 2024. The median participant age was 49 years (range 32-61); most were white (87%) and privately insured (91%). Median age at bone marrow transplantation (BMT) was 41 years (range 19-56). Primary diagnosis included acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome (65%). Reported complications included graft versus host disease (GVHD) (44%), chronic GVHD (39%), and vaginal GVHD (22%). Awareness of increased cervical cancer risk facilitated screening adherence, while limited access to in-network providers was a barrier. All participants preferred provider-collected screening due to confidence in test accuracy and reassurance from clinician involvement. Psychological factors, particularly worrying about recurrence or secondary cancers, strongly influenced screening preferences. CONCLUSION: Cervical cancer screening preferences among AlloHCT survivors were shaped by physical and psychological treatment-related factors. HPV self-collection may be a supplemental option before BMT, between annual clinic visits, or when access barriers arise.

title: Squamous Cell Anal Carcinoma: Current Therapeutic Approaches.
abstract: Anal squamous cell carcinoma (SCAC) is a relatively rare malignancy, but its incidence has been rising, largely due to infection with human papillomavirus (HPV), which is the main etiological driver. HPV vaccination and treatment of high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (HSIL) significantly lower the risk of progression to invasive cancer, while immunosuppressed individuals face a higher susceptibility to disease development. Most patients are diagnosed with localized SCAC, for which definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy remains the standard of care, offering high rates of disease control and overall survival Metastatic disease carries a poor prognosis and is primarily managed with systemic therapy with platinum-based chemotherapy is the preferred first-line treatment; recent phase III data established the combination of carboplatin-paclitaxel with retifanlimab (anti-PD1) as a new standard. Ongoing research is focused on HPV-targeted strategies and novel immunotherapies, which hold promise for further improving outcomes in both early and advanced stages of SCAC.
journal: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology

title_zh: 鳞状细胞肛门癌:当前的治疗方法。
source_body_en: Anal squamous cell carcinoma (SCAC) is a relatively rare malignancy, but its incidence has been rising, largely due to infection with human papillomavirus (HPV), which is the main etiological driver. HPV vaccination and treatment of high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (HSIL) significantly lower the risk of progression to invasive cancer, while immunosuppressed individuals face a higher susceptibility to disease development. Most patients are diagnosed with localized SCAC, for which definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy remains the standard of care, offering high rates of disease control and overall survival Metastatic disease carries a poor prognosis and is primarily managed with systemic therapy with platinum-based chemotherapy is the preferred first-line treatment; recent phase III data established the combination of carboplatin-paclitaxel with retifanlimab (anti-PD1) as a new standard. Ongoing research is focused on HPV-targeted strategies and novel immunotherapies, which hold promise for further improving outcomes in both early and advanced stages of SCAC.

title: Implementation and impact of primary HPV testing in cervical cancer screening: Historical perspectives and institutional experience at a large academic medical center.
abstract: Recognition of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) as the etiologic agent in nearly all cervical cancers has fundamentally reshaped screening strategies, driving the development and adoption of highly sensitive molecular HPV assays. Over the past several decades, cervical cancer screening guidelines have shifted from primarily cytology-based approaches toward HPV-based modalities, with primary HPV testing now recommended as the preferred method by the American Cancer Society and anticipated to be similarly endorsed by the United States Preventive Services Task Force. This article traces the evolution of cervical cancer screening, from the original Papanicolaou test to current guideline recommendations, and discusses the logistical requirements for transitioning to a primary HPV screening system, including triage strategies for HPV-positive cases. The authors additionally present an institutional experience of initiating primary HPV testing, highlighting its impact on cytopathology laboratory workflow and specimen volumes.

title: Differentiation-independent activation of HPV genome replication by the lncRNA DINO.
abstract: ABSTRACT Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) rely on multiple host cell factors to replicate the viral genome, yet the contribution of host long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) to viral genome maintenance and amplification in the productive life cycle remains poorly understood. In this study, we show that the lncRNA damage-induced long non-coding RNA (DINO) is a driver of HPV DNA replication. DINO levels increase during keratinocyte differentiation, and ectopic expression of DINO promotes both HPV genome replication and the formation of replication foci, and this is independent of keratinocyte differentiation signals. Ectopic DINO expression increases select early viral transcript levels, including E1^E4, E1, and E2. Notably, DINO’s subcellular localization is also context-dependent: during DNA damage, DINO is predominantly cytoplasmic, but during keratinocyte differentiation, nuclear retention is observed. This differential localization suggests that DINO has distinct functional roles in keratinocyte differentiation and HPV biology. Our findings highlight DINO as a lncRNA that promotes HPV genome replication and suggest that lncRNAs may play underappreciated roles in host-virus interactions. This work provides a foundation for further exploration of lncRNAs as potential therapeutic targets in HPV-associated diseases. IMPORTANCE Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are the causative agents of many anogenital tract and oral cancers, yet the host factors that trigger and support viral genome replication during the productive life cycle are incompletely understood. This study identifies the long non-coding RNA DINO as a host regulator that promotes HPV DNA replication, replication focus formation, and early viral gene expression independently of keratinocyte differentiation. We further show that DINO exhibits context-dependent subcellular localization, suggesting distinct functional roles in cellular stress responses and HPV biology. These findings reveal an underappreciated role for host lncRNAs in virus-host interactions and provide new insight into cellular pathways that support HPV genome replication.

In this study, we show that the lncRNA damage-induced long non-coding RNA (DINO) is a driver of HPV DNA replication. DINO levels increase during keratinocyte differentiation, and ectopic expression of DINO promotes both HPV genome replication and the formation of replication foci, and this is independent of keratinocyte differentiation signals. Ectopic DINO expression increases select early viral transcript levels, including E1^E4, E1, and E2. Notably, DINO’s subcellular localization is also context-dependent: during DNA damage, DINO is predominantly cytoplasmic, but during keratinocyte differentiation, nuclear retention is observed. This differential localization suggests that DINO has distinct functional roles in keratinocyte differentiation and HPV biology. Our findings highlight DINO as a lncRNA that promotes HPV genome replication and suggest that lncRNAs may play underappreciated roles in host-virus interactions. This work provides a foundation for further exploration of lncRNAs as potential therapeutic targets in HPV-associated diseases. IMPORTANCE Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are the causative agents of many anogenital tract and oral cancers, yet the host factors that trigger and support viral genome replication during the productive life cycle are incompletely understood. This study identifies the long non-coding RNA DINO as a host regulator that promotes HPV DNA replication, replication focus formation, and early viral gene expression independently of keratinocyte differentiation. We further show that DINO exhibits context-dependent subcellular localization, suggesting distinct functional roles in cellular stress responses and HPV biology. These findings reveal an underappreciated role for host lncRNAs in virus-host interactions and provide new insight into cellular pathways that support HPV genome replication.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) rely on multiple host cell factors to replicate the viral genome, yet the contribution of host long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) to viral genome maintenance and amplification in the productive life cycle remains poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study investigated the role of the lncRNA DINO in HPV DNA replication using keratinocytes, examining its effects on viral genome replication, replication foci formation, and early viral gene expression.
analysis.methods: The study measured DINO levels during keratinocyte differentiation, performed ectopic expression of DINO, and assessed its impact on HPV genome replication, replication foci formation, and early viral transcript levels, including E1^E4, E1, and E2.
analysis.main_results: DINO levels increase during keratinocyte differentiation, and ectopic expression of DINO promotes HPV genome replication and replication foci formation independently of keratinocyte differentiation signals, while also increasing select early viral transcript levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret DINO as a driver of HPV DNA replication, highlighting its underappreciated role in host-virus interactions, and note its context-dependent subcellular localization suggesting distinct functional roles in keratinocyte differentiation and HPV biology.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide a foundation for exploring lncRNAs as potential therapeutic targets in HPV-associated diseases, offering new insights into cellular pathways that support HPV genome replication.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study is based on in vitro experiments in keratinocytes, and while the findings are significant, further in vivo validation is needed to confirm the therapeutic potential of targeting DINO.

analysis.summary_en: This study identifies the long non-coding RNA DINO as a key regulator of human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA replication. The researchers found that DINO levels increase during keratinocyte differentiation and that its ectopic expression promotes HPV genome replication and replication foci formation independently of differentiation signals. DINO also enhances the expression of early viral transcripts, including E1^E4, E1, and E2. The study reveals that DINO exhibits context-dependent subcellular localization, suggesting distinct roles in cellular stress responses and HPV biology. These findings highlight an underappreciated role for host lncRNAs in virus-host interactions and provide new insights into potential therapeutic targets for HPV-associated diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 依赖多种 宿主 细胞因子来复制病毒 基因组,但 宿主 长非编码 RNA (lncRNA) 对病毒 基因组 在生产生命周期中维持和扩增的贡献仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用角质形成细胞研究了 lncRNA DINO 在 HPV DNA 复制中的作用,检查其对病毒 基因组 复制、复制灶形成和早期病毒基因表达的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究测量了角质形成细胞分化过程中的DINO水平,进行了DINO的异位表达,并评估了其对HPV 基因组复制、复制灶形成和早期病毒转录水平(包括E1^E4、E1和E2)的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: DINO 水平在角质形成细胞分化过程中增加,并且 DINO 的异位表达可独立于角质形成细胞分化信号促进 HPV 基因组 复制和复制灶形成,同时还增加选择的早期病毒转录物水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 DINO 解释为 HPV DNA 复制的驱动因素,强调了其在 宿主 与病毒相互作用中未被充分认识的作用,并指出其上下文依赖的亚细胞定位表明在角质形成细胞分化和 HPV 生物学中具有不同的功能作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为探索lncRNA作为HPV相关疾病的潜在治疗靶点奠定了基础,并为支持HPV 基因组复制的细胞途径提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是基于角质形成细胞的体外实验,虽然研究结果很重要,但需要进一步的体内验证来确认靶向 DINO 的治疗潜力。

title: Therapeutic resistance in HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma: molecular mechanisms, clinical challenges, and precision strategies
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) exhibits exceptional sensitivity to chemoradiotherapy, with 5-year overall survival exceeding 80%, thereby providing a compelling rationale for treatment de-escalation. However, 15%–20% of patients develop therapeutic resistance and locoregional recurrence, resulting in markedly inferior outcomes. This Review systematically dissects the molecular architecture of treatment resistance in HPV-positive OPSCC, with particular emphasis on mechanisms conferring resistance to radiotherapy, platinum-based chemotherapy, and EGFR-targeted therapy (cetuximab). We delineate core drivers — aberrant DNA damage response (DDR) signaling, epigenetic reprogramming, cancer stem cell (CSC) plasticity, and non-coding RNA networks—and pinpoint actionable vulnerabilities. The contributions and limitations of patient-derived organoids, genetically engineered mouse models, and pivotal clinical trials (notably RTOG 1016) are critically appraised. We address persistent controversies, including the complex relationship between de-escalation and resistance, and highlight the lack of integrative resistance biomarkers. Finally, we propose a roadmap to bridge translational gaps and accelerate the development of precision strategies that circumvent resistance.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines therapeutic resistance in HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC), which, despite high chemoradiotherapy sensitivity (5-year survival >80%), affects 15%–20% of patients, leading to poor outcomes. The review critiques models like patient-derived organoids and clinical trials (e.g., RTOG 1016), addresses controversies around de-escalation and biomarker gaps, and proposes strategies to develop precision interventions to overcome resistance.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 HPV 阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 的治疗耐药性,研究分子机制、临床挑战以及解决放化疗、铂类化疗和 EGFR 靶向治疗耐药性的精准策略。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述系统地剖析了 HPV 阳性 OPSCC 中 治疗 耐药的分子结构,批判性地评价了源自患者的类器官、基因工程小鼠模型和关键临床试验(特别是 RTOG 1016)的贡献和局限性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HPV 阳性 OPSCC 对放化疗表现出异常的敏感性,5 年总生存率超过 80%,但 15%–20% 的患者出现治疗耐药和局部复发。耐药性的核心驱动因素包括异常的 DNA 损伤反应信号、表观遗传重编程、癌症干细胞可塑性和非编码 RNA 网络。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 持续存在的争议包括 治疗 降级和耐药之间的复杂关系,以及缺乏综合耐药生物标志物。审查强调了未解决的机制和对可采取行动的漏洞的需求。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 提出了一个路线图,以弥合转化差距并加速制定规避耐药性的精准策略,强调需要综合生物标志物和有针对性的干预措施。

title_zh: HPV 阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌的治疗耐药:分子机制、临床挑战和精准策略
source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) exhibits exceptional sensitivity to chemoradiotherapy, with 5-year overall survival exceeding 80%, thereby providing a compelling rationale for treatment de-escalation. However, 15%–20% of patients develop therapeutic resistance and locoregional recurrence, resulting in markedly inferior outcomes. This Review systematically dissects the molecular architecture of treatment resistance in HPV-positive OPSCC, with particular emphasis on mechanisms conferring resistance to radiotherapy, platinum-based chemotherapy, and EGFR-targeted therapy (cetuximab). We delineate core drivers — aberrant DNA damage response (DDR) signaling, epigenetic reprogramming, cancer stem cell (CSC) plasticity, and non-coding RNA networks—and pinpoint actionable vulnerabilities. The contributions and limitations of patient-derived organoids, genetically engineered mouse models, and pivotal clinical trials (notably RTOG 1016) are critically appraised. We address persistent controversies, including the complex relationship between de-escalation and resistance, and highlight the lack of integrative resistance biomarkers. Finally, we propose a roadmap to bridge translational gaps and accelerate the development of precision strategies that circumvent resistance.

title: [Testicular Germ Cell Tumors and Penile Cancer: Molecular-Based Diagnosis and Treatment].
abstract: Molecular diagnostics and targeted therapies are increasingly evolving towards a personalized medicine approach. This review summarizes recent advances in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) and penile cancer, with a focus on emerging biomarkers and targeted therapeutic strategies. Conventional serum tumor markers such as AFP, β-HCG, and LDH remain important but are limited by suboptimal sensitivity and specificity. Novel biomarkers, particularly microRNA miR-371a-3p, have demonstrated substantially higher diagnostic accuracy and may improve risk stratification, detection of disease recurrence, and treatment decision-making in TGCTs. In addition, the analysis of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) has emerged as a promising liquid biopsy procedure. In penile squamous cell carcinoma, molecular classification based on human papillomavirus (HPV) status and comprehensive genomic profiling are becoming increasingly relevant for prognosis and therapeutic selection. The identification of actionable molecular alterations has facilitated the development of immunotherapy, anti-EGFR strategies, and antibody-drug conjugates. Early clinical data also suggest that ctDNA may provide valuable information for treatment monitoring and early relapse detection. Despite these promising findings, further prospective studies and standardized methodologies are required before many of these approaches can be incorporated into routine clinical practice. Overall, these developments highlight the ongoing transition towards biomarker-driven precision oncology and the potential for more individualized management of patients with TGCTs and penile cancer.

source_records.title: Testikuläre Keimzelltumoren und Peniskarzinom – Molekularbasierte Diagnostik und Therapie
source_records.abstract: Zusammenfassung Die molekulare Diagnostik und Therapie urologischer Tumoren entwickelt sich zunehmend hin zu einer personalisierten Medizin. Der vorliegende Übersichtsartikel beleuchtet aktuelle Entwicklungen bei testikulären Keimzelltumoren (TGCT) und dem Peniskarzinom mit besonderem Fokus auf innovative Biomarker und zielgerichtete Therapiekonzepte. Bei TGCT weisen klassische Serumtumormarker wie AFP, β-HCG und LDH nur eine begrenzte Sensitivität und Spezifität auf. Neue Biomarker, insbesondere die MicroRNA miR-371a-3p, zeigen dagegen eine deutlich höhere diagnostische Genauigkeit und ermöglichen eine verbesserte Risikoabschätzung, Rezidiverkennung und Therapieplanung. Darüber hinaus gewinnt die Analyse zirkulierender Tumor-DNA (ctDNA) als Liquid-Biopsy-Verfahren an Bedeutung. Beim Peniskarzinom spielen die molekulare Klassifikation anhand des HPV-Status sowie genomische Analysen eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle. Die Identifikation therapeutisch relevanter Alterationen eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten für Immuntherapien, Anti-EGFR-Strategien und Antibody-Drug Conjugates. Erste Studien zur ctDNA zeigen zudem ein großes Potenzial für Therapiemonitoring und Früherkennung von Rezidiven. Trotz vielversprechender Ergebnisse sind weitere prospektive Studien und standardisierte Verfahren erforderlich, bevor viele dieser Ansätze in die klinische Routine integriert werden können. Insgesamt verdeutlichen die aktuellen Entwicklungen den Wandel hin zu einer biomarkerbasierten Präzisionsmedizin in der Uroonkologie.

title: Evolution of hazard of recurrence and death after surgery for oropharyngeal cancer according to HPV status.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-related oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) is associated with improved survival compared with HPV-negative disease. However, limited evidence is available on how the risk of recurrence and cancer-related death evolves according to HPV status. METHODS: This multicentre retrospective cohort study included patients who underwent upfront surgery with neck dissection for OPSCC between 2010 and 2022. HPV status was determined by p16 immunohistochemistry. Overall survival, cancer-specific survival, disease-free survival, and disease-free specific survival were estimated using Kaplan-Meier methods. Time-varying hazard rates (HR) for cancer-related death, local recurrence, regional recurrence, distant metastasis, and secondary primary tumor were estimated over a five-year period using nonparametric smoothed hazard functions, stratified by p16 status. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how the risk of recurrence and cancer-related death evolves after surgery for oropharyngeal cancer (OPSCC) according to human papillomavirus (HPV) status. analysis_zh.methods: HPV 状态通过 p16 免疫组织化学测定。使用Kaplan-Meier方法估计总生存期、癌症特异性生存期、无病生存期和无病特异性生存期。使用非参数平滑风险函数,按 p16 状态分层,估计五年内癌症相关死亡、局部复发、区域复发、远处转移和继发性原发肿瘤的时变风险率 (HR)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 650 名患者中,284 名(43.7%)患有 p16 阳性肿瘤。两组中癌症相关的 死亡率 在术后第二年达到峰值,但 p16 阴性患者比 p16 阳性患者出现更早且水平明显更高(15 个月与 18 个月;年 HR:12.7% vs 4.1%)。p16 阴性患者的局部和区域复发风险在头两年内最高,与 p16 阳性患者相比,p16 阴性患者的复发风险显着更高且持续时间更长。p16 阴性患者发生第二原发肿瘤的风险高于 p16 阳性患者,且在随访期间两组几乎保持不变。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: OPSCC 手术后复发和癌症相关死亡的风险在大小和时间上根据 p16 状态而有所不同。危险函数分析提供了超出传统生存估计的临床相关信息,并可支持 OPSCC 中随时间调整的随访策略和患者咨询。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可能支持 OPSCC 中适时的随访策略和患者咨询。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项回顾性 队列研究 研究,可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。证据是温和的,因为它是基于观察数据。

title: Psychosocial factors influencing HPV vaccination intention among male college students in Hangzhou city: A cross-sectional study based on an extended theory of planned behavior model.
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination for males is critical for reducing the global burden of HPV-related diseases. This study utilized an extended Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) framework to identify determinants of vaccination intentions among Chinese male undergraduate students. A cross-sectional study was conducted between March and May 2025 in Hangzhou, China, recruiting 1,310 participants via multi-stage stratified cluster sampling. The dependent variable was vaccination intention. Independent variables included sociodemographics, TPB constructs (behavior attitude [BA], subjective norms [SN], and perceived behavioral control [PBC]), HPV knowledge and risk perception. We employed a three-step hierarchical linear model (Model 1: sociodemographics; Model 2: adding TPB constructs; Model 3: adding HPV knowledge/risk) and structural equation modeling (SEM) to test latent paths. Among the 1,310 participants (balanced across four academic years), 62.7% expressed a willingness to receive the HPV vaccine. Hierarchical regression revealed that sociodemographics explained 2.1% of the variance in vaccination intention (Model 1), which increased to 25.1% with the inclusion of TPB constructs (Model 2), and reached 32.7% in the final model (Model 3) (F = 126.245, p < .001). SEM analysis further validated the model (χ2/df = 2.102, RMSEA = 0.068, GFI = 0.968), accounting for 75.9% of the total variance in behavioral intention. PBC was identified as the most powerful predictor (β = 0.527, p < .001), followed by BA, SN and HPV-related knowledge. Additionally, higher self-assessed risk of infection significantly predicted stronger intentions. The results of this study indicated that increasing vaccination rates requires policy interventions to improve vaccine accessibility and affordability, alongside fostering positive attitudes and social support through targeted health education.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health need to increase HPV vaccination uptake among males by identifying psychosocial determinants of vaccination intention using an extended Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) framework.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted between March and May 2025 in Hangzhou, China, enrolling 1,310 male undergraduate students via multi-stage stratified cluster sampling.
analysis.methods: Hierarchical linear models (three steps) and structural equation modeling (SEM) were used to quantify the contributions of sociodemographics, TPB constructs (behavior attitude, subjective norms, perceived behavioral control), HPV knowledge, and risk perception to vaccination intention.
analysis.main_results: In the final model, TPB constructs and knowledge explained 32.7% of variance in vaccination intention (F = 126.245, p < .001), with perceived behavioral control the strongest predictor (β = 0.527, p < .001), followed by behavior attitude, subjective norms, and HPV-related knowledge.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing that perceived behavioral control and attitudes are key levers for increasing male HPV vaccination intention, highlighting the value of an extended TPB model in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that policy interventions should prioritize improving vaccine accessibility and affordability while strengthening positive attitudes and social support through targeted health education to raise male HPV vaccination rates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and reliance on self-reported intention may overestimate future uptake; the evidence is assessed as moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Hangzhou, China, assessed psychosocial determinants of HPV vaccination intention among 1,310 male college students using an extended Theory of Planned Behavior model. Hierarchical regression and structural equation modeling showed that perceived behavioral control, behavior attitude, subjective norms, and HPV-related knowledge together explained 32.7% of variance in vaccination intention, with perceived behavioral control the strongest predictor. The authors conclude that improving vaccine accessibility and affordability alongside targeted health education to foster positive attitudes and social support could increase male HPV vaccination uptake.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过使用扩展的计划行为理论 (TPB) 框架确定 疫苗接种 意图的心理社会决定因素,解决了增加男性 HPV 疫苗接种 摄取的公共卫生需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 3 月至 5 月在中国杭州进行了一项横断面研究,通过多阶段分层整群抽样招募了 1,310 名男本科生。
elements_zh.methods: 使用分层线性模型(三步)和结构方程模型(SEM)来量化社会人口统计学、TPB 结构(行为态度、主观规范、感知行为控制)、HPV 知识和风险感知对 疫苗接种 意图的贡献。
elements_zh.main_results: 在最终模型中,TPB 结构和知识解释了 疫苗接种 意图的 32.7% 方差 (F = 126.245,p < .001),感知行为控制是最强的预测因子 (β = 0.527,p < .001),其次是行为态度、主观规范和 HPV 相关知识。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者对研究结果的解释是,感知行为控制和态度是增加男性 HPV 疫苗接种 意图的关键杠杆,强调了扩展 TPB 模型在该人群中的价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,政策干预措施应优先考虑提高 疫苗 的可及性和可负担性,同时通过有针对性的健康教育加强积极态度和社会支持,以提高男性 HPV 疫苗接种 率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横截面设计限制了因果推断,并且对自我报告意图的依赖可能会高估未来的采用率;由于这些限制,证据被评估为中等。

analysis_en.methods: Hierarchical linear models (three steps) and structural equation modeling (SEM) were used to quantify the contributions of sociodemographics, TPB constructs (behavior attitude, subjective norms, perceived behavioral control), HPV knowledge, and risk perception to vaccination intention.
analysis_en.main_results: In the final model, TPB constructs and knowledge explained 32.7% of variance in vaccination intention (F = 126.245, p < .001), with perceived behavioral control the strongest predictor (β = 0.527, p < .001), followed by behavior attitude, subjective norms, and HPV-related knowledge.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing that perceived behavioral control and attitudes are key levers for increasing male HPV vaccination intention, highlighting the value of an extended TPB model in this population.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that policy interventions should prioritize improving vaccine accessibility and affordability while strengthening positive attitudes and social support through targeted health education to raise male HPV vaccination rates.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and reliance on self-reported intention may overestimate future uptake; the evidence is assessed as moderate due to these limitations.

title_zh: 影响杭州市男大学生HPV 疫苗接种意向的心理社会因素——基于计划行为模型扩展理论的横断面研究
source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination for males is critical for reducing the global burden of HPV-related diseases. This study utilized an extended Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) framework to identify determinants of vaccination intentions among Chinese male undergraduate students. A cross-sectional study was conducted between March and May 2025 in Hangzhou, China, recruiting 1,310 participants via multi-stage stratified cluster sampling. The dependent variable was vaccination intention. Independent variables included sociodemographics, TPB constructs (behavior attitude [BA], subjective norms [SN], and perceived behavioral control [PBC]), HPV knowledge and risk perception. We employed a three-step hierarchical linear model (Model 1: sociodemographics; Model 2: adding TPB constructs; Model 3: adding HPV knowledge/risk) and structural equation modeling (SEM) to test latent paths. Among the 1,310 participants (balanced across four academic years), 62.7% expressed a willingness to receive the HPV vaccine. Hierarchical regression revealed that sociodemographics explained 2.1% of the variance in vaccination intention (Model 1), which increased to 25.1% with the inclusion of TPB constructs (Model 2), and reached 32.7% in the final model (Model 3) (F = 126.245, p < .001). SEM analysis further validated the model (χ2/df = 2.102, RMSEA = 0.068, GFI = 0.968), accounting for 75.9% of the total variance in behavioral intention. PBC was identified as the most powerful predictor (β = 0.527, p < .001), followed by BA, SN and HPV-related knowledge. Additionally, higher self-assessed risk of infection significantly predicted stronger intentions. The results of this study indicated that increasing vaccination rates requires policy interventions to improve vaccine accessibility and affordability, alongside fostering positive attitudes and social support through targeted health education.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 男性 人乳头瘤病毒 对于减少 HPV 相关疾病的全球负担至关重要。本研究利用扩展的计划行为理论 (TPB) 框架来确定中国男本科生 疫苗接种 意图的决定因素。2025 年 3 月至 5 月在中国杭州进行了一项横断面研究,通过多阶段分层整群抽样招募了 1,310 名参与者。因变量是 疫苗接种 意图。自变量包括社会人口统计学、TPB 结构(行为态度 [BA]、主观规范 [SN] 和感知行为控制 [PBC])、HPV 知识和风险感知。我们采用三步分层线性模型(模型 1:社会人口统计学;模型 2:添加 TPB 结构;模型 3:添加 HPV 知识/风险)和结构方程模型 (SEM) 来测试潜在路径。在 1,310 名参与者中(平衡四个学年),62.7% 表示愿意接受 HPV 疫苗。分层回归显示,社会人口统计学解释了 疫苗接种 意图(模型 1)中 2.1% 的方差,随着包含 TPB 结构(模型 2),该方差增加到 25.1%,并在最终模型(模型 3)中达到 32.7%(F = 126.245,p < .001)。SEM分析进一步验证了模型(χ2/df = 2.102,RMSEA = 0.068,GFI = 0.968),占行为意图总方差的75.9%。PBC 被认为是最有力的预测因子(β = 0.527,p < .001),其次是 BA、SN 和 HPV 相关知识。此外,较高的自我评估感染风险显着预示着更强烈的意图。这项研究的结果表明,提高 疫苗接种 率需要政策干预来提高 疫苗 的可及性和负担能力,同时通过有针对性的健康教育培养积极态度和社会支持。

title: Molecular basis of the HPV E7-ZER1 axis reveals a ligandable vulnerability in HPV-positive cancers.
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs), notably HPV-16 and HPV-18, underlies most cervical cancers and many head and neck cancers. Here, we report the structural and functional basis by which the viral oncoprotein E7 hijacks host CRL2 ZER1 to degrade retinoblastoma (Rb) protein and drive E2F-dependent proliferation. Crystal structures reveal that the N-terminal MH/N-degron of E7 engages a defined pocket within the armadillo (ARM)-repeat domain of ZER1. Disruption of this interface abolishes E7-ZER1 binding, prevents Rb degradation, silences E2F transcriptional programs, and impairs proliferation of HPV-positive cancer cells. Guided by these insights, we identify a first-in-class small-molecule inhibitor that blocks E7-ZER1 association, restores Rb stability, and selectively suppresses HPV-positive tumor growth in vivo . These results define a viral mimicry mechanism and nominate the ZER1 degron pocket as a ligandable therapeutic target for HPV-driven malignancies, highlighting translational opportunities for targeted therapy.

title_zh: HPV E7-ZER1 轴的分子基础揭示了 HPV 阳性癌症的配体脆弱性。
source_body_en: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses (HPVs), notably HPV-16 and HPV-18, underlies most cervical cancers and many head and neck cancers. Here, we report the structural and functional basis by which the viral oncoprotein E7 hijacks host CRL2 ZER1 to degrade retinoblastoma (Rb) protein and drive E2F-dependent proliferation. Crystal structures reveal that the N-terminal MH/N-degron of E7 engages a defined pocket within the armadillo (ARM)-repeat domain of ZER1. Disruption of this interface abolishes E7-ZER1 binding, prevents Rb degradation, silences E2F transcriptional programs, and impairs proliferation of HPV-positive cancer cells. Guided by these insights, we identify a first-in-class small-molecule inhibitor that blocks E7-ZER1 association, restores Rb stability, and selectively suppresses HPV-positive tumor growth in vivo . These results define a viral mimicry mechanism and nominate the ZER1 degron pocket as a ligandable therapeutic target for HPV-driven malignancies, highlighting translational opportunities for targeted therapy.
abstract_zh: 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)(特别是 HPV-16 和 HPV-18)的持续感染是大多数 宫颈癌 和许多头颈癌的基础。在此,我们报告了病毒癌蛋白 E7 劫持 宿主 CRL2 ZER1 以降解视网膜母细胞瘤 (Rb) 蛋白并驱动 E2F 依赖性增殖的结构和功能基础。晶体结构表明,E7 的 N 端 MH/N-degron 与 ZER1 的犰狳 (ARM) 重复结构域内的一个确定的口袋接合。破坏该界面会消除 E7-ZER1 结合,防止 Rb 降解,沉默 E2F 转录程序,并损害 HPV 阳性癌细胞的增殖。在这些见解的指导下,我们确定了一种一流的小分子抑制剂,可以阻断 E7-ZER1 关联、恢复 Rb 稳定性并选择性抑制体内 HPV 阳性肿瘤的生长。这些结果定义了病毒拟态机制,并指定 ZER1 降解决定子口袋作为 HPV 驱动的恶性肿瘤的可配体治疗靶点,突出了靶向治疗的转化机会。

title: Availability and Utilization of the Cervical Cancer (HPV) Vaccine among Reproductive-Age Women in KELGA, Rivers State
abstract: Cervical cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related morbidity and mortality among women in Nigeria, despite the availability of an effective preventive human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine. Uptake of the vaccine remains low in several communities, including Igwuruta, Omagwa, and Aluu in Ikwerre Local Government Area (KELGA), Rivers State, where health facility records and anecdotal evidence suggest continued presentation of advanced cervical disease that timely vaccination could have prevented. This study assessed the availability of the cervical cancer vaccine and its level of utilization among reproductive-age women attending immunization clinics in KELGA, and examined the relationship between these two constructs and overall vaccine acceptance. A cross-sectional descriptive survey design was adopted, and a structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire was used to collect data from 325 reproductive-age women (15–49 years) selected through simple random sampling across three primary health centres, out of 379 questionnaires administered (85.5% response rate). Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics (frequencies, percentages, means, and standard deviations) and the Chi-square test of independence, tested at a 0.05 level of significance. Results showed generally favourable perceptions of both availability (grand mean = 3.32) and utilization (grand mean = 3.31) of the vaccine. Chi-square analysis revealed statistically significant relationships between availability and acceptance (X2 = 159.099, df = 1, p = .000) and between utilization and acceptance (X2 = 125.294, df = 1, p = .000), leading to rejection of both null hypotheses. The study concludes that vaccine availability and utilization are significant determinants of acceptance in this population, though occasional stock shortages and lower rates of completing the full dosing schedule remain areas of concern. It is recommended that health authorities strengthen vaccine supply chain management and institute structured follow-up systems to support full dose completion, thereby improving overall cervical cancer vaccine acceptance and coverage in similar community settings.

abstract_zh: 尽管有有效的预防性 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗,但 宫颈癌 仍然是尼日利亚女性癌症相关发病率和 死亡率 的主要原因之一。在一些社区,包括河流州 Ikwerre 地方政府区 (KELGA) 的 Igwuruta、Omagwa 和 Aluu,疫苗 的使用率仍然较低,这些社区的卫生机构记录和轶事证据表明,晚期宫颈疾病持续出现,而及时 疫苗接种 本来可以预防。本研究评估了 宫颈癌 疫苗 的可用性及其在 KELGA 免疫诊所就诊的育龄妇女中的利用水平,并检验了这两种结构与总体 疫苗 接受度之间的关系。采用横断面描述性调查设计,并使用访谈员填写的结构化问卷来收集 325 名育龄妇女(15-49 岁)的数据,这些妇女是通过三个初级卫生中心的简单随机抽样从 379 份问卷中选出的(85.5% 的答复率)。使用描述性统计(频率、百分比、平均值和标准差)和卡方独立性检验对数据进行分析,显着性水平为 0.05。结果显示,人们对 疫苗 的可用性(总平均值 = 3.32)和利用率(总平均值 = 3.31)普遍持积极态度。卡方分析揭示了可用性和接受度之间 (X2 = 159.099,df = 1,p = .000) 以及利用率和接受度之间 (X2 = 125.294,df = 1,p = .000) 之间存在统计显着关系,导致拒绝两个原假设。该研究得出的结论是,疫苗 的可用性和利用率是该人群接受的重要决定因素,尽管偶尔的库存短缺和完成完整给药计划的较低率仍然是令人担忧的领域。建议卫生当局加强 疫苗 供应链管理并建立结构化的随访系统以支持全部剂量完成,从而提高类似社区环境中 宫颈癌 疫苗 的总体接受度和覆盖率。

title: Characterization of persistent HPV-specific activated T cells in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
abstract: Background Human papillomavirus-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (HPV + OPSCC) generally has favorable outcomes yet remains prone to late recurrence. Durable control likely depends on persistent tumor-specific CD8+ T cells, but their persistence and function in metastasis are poorly understood. Methods We integrated bulk RNA sequencing ( n = 56) with single-cell RNA and paired T-cell receptor (TCR) sequencing of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells ( n = 4), including a longitudinal primary-lung metastasis pair obtained three years after curative therapy. HPV genotyping, HLA typing, epitope prediction, and NFAT-reporter Jurkat-luciferase assays were used to identify and functionally validate HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. Repertoire tracking and single-cell/bulk transcriptomics were evaluated. Results HPV + tumors showed higher inferred CD8+ T cell infiltration and more favorable prognosis than HPV- tumors. Single-cell analysis revealed oligoclonally expanded exhausted clusters enriched in HPV tumor-specific CD8+ T cells. We isolated and functionally validated nine patient-derived HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. High-avidity receptors recognizing an alternatively spliced region in E6 (aa 49-110; E6*) persisted in metastatic lesions, whereas lower-avidity clones, including an E7_11-19-specific TCR currently under clinical investigation, were lost. Compared with the primary tumor, metastatic lesions showed reduced stem-like/TCF7-associated CD8+ T-cell populations and enrichment of HPV-specific CD8+ T cells expressing KLRB1 and ZNF683 , consistent with a tissue-adapted TRM-like transcriptional state with inhibitory signaling features. Conclusions High-avidity, KLRB1 + HPV-specific CD8+ T cells represent a persistent effector subset with prognostic and therapeutic relevance to HPV + OPSCC. Their persistence in metastatic lesions and association with reduced recurrence risk support further investigation of KLRB1 -associated HPV-reactive T-cell states as biomarkers and immunotherapeutic targets.

METHODS We integrated bulk RNA sequencing (n = 56) with single-cell RNA and paired T-cell receptor (TCR) sequencing of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells (n = 4), including a longitudinal primary-lung metastasis pair obtained three years after curative therapy. HPV genotyping, HLA typing, epitope prediction, and NFAT-reporter Jurkat-luciferase assays were used to identify and functionally validate HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. Repertoire tracking and single-cell/bulk transcriptomics were evaluated. RESULTS HPV + tumors showed higher inferred CD8+ T cell infiltration and more favorable prognosis than HPV- tumors. Single-cell analysis revealed oligoclonally expanded exhausted clusters enriched in HPV tumor-specific CD8+ T cells. We isolated and functionally validated nine patient-derived HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. High-avidity receptors recognizing an alternatively spliced region in E6 (aa 49-110; E6*) persisted in metastatic lesions, whereas lower-avidity clones, including an E7_11-19-specific TCR currently under clinical investigation, were lost. Compared with the primary tumor, metastatic lesions showed reduced stem-like/TCF7-associated CD8+ T-cell populations and enrichment of HPV-specific CD8+ T cells expressing KLRB1 and ZNF683, consistent with a tissue-adapted TRM-like transcriptional state with inhibitory signaling features. CONCLUSIONS High-avidity, KLRB1 + HPV-specific CD8+ T cells represent a persistent effector subset with prognostic and therapeutic relevance to HPV + OPSCC. Their persistence in metastatic lesions and association with reduced recurrence risk support further investigation of KLRB1-associated HPV-reactive T-cell states as biomarkers and immunotherapeutic targets.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated persistent HPV-specific activated T cells in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), focusing on HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (HPV + OPSCC). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌(HPV + OPSCC)通常具有良好的结果,但仍然容易出现晚期复发。持久的控制可能取决于持续存在的肿瘤特异性 CD8+ T 细胞,但它们的持续存在和在转移中的功能尚不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 方法 我们将批量 RNA 测序 (n = 56) 与肿瘤浸润 CD8+ T 细胞 (n = 4) 的单细胞 RNA 和配对 T 细胞受体 (TCR) 测序相结合,包括在治疗三年后获得的纵向原发性肺转移对。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 HPV 基因分型、HLA 分型、表位预测和 NFAT 报告 Jurkat 荧光素酶测定来识别 HPV16 E6/E7 特异性 TCR 并进行功能验证。评估了库追踪和单细胞/批量转录组学。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 HPV + 肿瘤比 HPV- 肿瘤表现出更高的推断 CD8+ T 细胞浸润和更好的预后。单细胞分析显示,寡克隆扩增的耗尽簇富含 HPV 肿瘤特异性 CD8+ T 细胞。与原发性肿瘤相比,转移性病灶显示干细胞样/TCF7相关CD8+T细胞群减少,并且表达KLRB1和ZNF683的HPV特异性CD8+T细胞富集。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 高亲合力 KLRB1 + HPV 特异性 CD8+ T 细胞代表了与 HPV + OPSCC 具有预后和治疗相关性的持续效应子亚群。它们在转移性病变中的持续存在以及与复发风险降低的相关性支持对 KLRB1 相关 HPV 反应性 T 细胞状态作为生物标志物和免疫治疗靶点的进一步研究。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,高亲和力 HPV 特异性 T 细胞可以作为 HPV + OPSCC 复发风险的生物标志物和免疫治疗的靶点,通过有针对性的干预措施可能改善患者的预后。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管纵向设计和功能验证强化了研究结果,但由于样本量较小(单细胞测序 n = 4)以及某些分析依赖推断数据,该研究的证据强度中等。

title_zh: 头颈鳞状细胞癌中持续性 HPV 特异性活化 T 细胞的特征。
source_body_en: Background Human papillomavirus-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (HPV + OPSCC) generally has favorable outcomes yet remains prone to late recurrence. Durable control likely depends on persistent tumor-specific CD8+ T cells, but their persistence and function in metastasis are poorly understood. Methods We integrated bulk RNA sequencing ( n = 56) with single-cell RNA and paired T-cell receptor (TCR) sequencing of tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells ( n = 4), including a longitudinal primary-lung metastasis pair obtained three years after curative therapy. HPV genotyping, HLA typing, epitope prediction, and NFAT-reporter Jurkat-luciferase assays were used to identify and functionally validate HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. Repertoire tracking and single-cell/bulk transcriptomics were evaluated. Results HPV + tumors showed higher inferred CD8+ T cell infiltration and more favorable prognosis than HPV- tumors. Single-cell analysis revealed oligoclonally expanded exhausted clusters enriched in HPV tumor-specific CD8+ T cells. We isolated and functionally validated nine patient-derived HPV16 E6/E7-specific TCRs. High-avidity receptors recognizing an alternatively spliced region in E6 (aa 49-110; E6*) persisted in metastatic lesions, whereas lower-avidity clones, including an E7_11-19-specific TCR currently under clinical investigation, were lost. Compared with the primary tumor, metastatic lesions showed reduced stem-like/TCF7-associated CD8+ T-cell populations and enrichment of HPV-specific CD8+ T cells expressing KLRB1 and ZNF683 , consistent with a tissue-adapted TRM-like transcriptional state with inhibitory signaling features. Conclusions High-avidity, KLRB1 + HPV-specific CD8+ T cells represent a persistent effector subset with prognostic and therapeutic relevance to HPV + OPSCC. Their persistence in metastatic lesions and association with reduced recurrence risk support further investigation of KLRB1 -associated HPV-reactive T-cell states as biomarkers and immunotherapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 背景 人乳头瘤病毒 阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌(HPV + OPSCC)通常具有良好的结果,但仍然容易出现晚期复发。持久的控制可能取决于持续存在的肿瘤特异性 CD8+ T 细胞,但它们的持续存在和在转移中的功能尚不清楚。方法 我们将批量 RNA 测序 (n = 56) 与肿瘤浸润 CD8+ T 细胞 (n = 4) 的单细胞 RNA 和配对 T 细胞受体 (TCR) 测序相结合,包括在治疗三年后获得的纵向原发性肺转移对。使用 HPV 基因分型、HLA 分型、表位预测和 NFAT 报告 Jurkat 荧光素酶测定来识别 HPV16 E6/E7 特异性 TCR 并进行功能验证。评估了库追踪和单细胞/批量转录组学。结果 HPV + 肿瘤比 HPV- 肿瘤表现出更高的推断 CD8+ T 细胞浸润和更好的预后。单细胞分析显示,寡克隆扩增的耗尽簇富含 HPV 肿瘤特异性 CD8+ T 细胞。我们分离并功能验证了九种源自患者的 HPV16 E6/E7 特异性 TCR。识别 E6 中选择性剪接区域(aa 49-110;E6*)的高亲和力受体在转移性病变中持续存在,而低亲和力克隆,包括目前正在临床研究的 E7_11-19 特异性 TCR,则丢失了。与原发性肿瘤相比,转移性病灶表现出干细胞样/TCF7相关CD8+ T细胞群减少,以及表达KLRB1和ZNF683的HPV特异性CD8+ T细胞富集,这与具有抑制信号传导特征的组织适应TRM样转录状态一致。结论 高亲合力 KLRB1 + HPV 特异性 CD8+ T 细胞代表了与 HPV + OPSCC 具有预后和治疗相关性的持续效应子亚群。它们在转移性病变中的持续存在以及与复发风险降低的相关性支持对 KLRB1 相关 HPV 反应性 T 细胞状态作为生物标志物和免疫治疗靶点的进一步研究。

title: Overcoming immunization Gaps: Identifying Modifiable Barriers to HPV Vaccination in Chinese Patients with Autoimmune Inflammatory Rheumatic Diseases (AIIRDs)
abstract: Abstract [Background and Objectives] Women with autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRDs) are more vulnerable to human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and HPV-related cervical cancers, however, the HPV screening and vaccination rate was low. We conducted a real-world survey to evaluate the awareness and status of HPV vaccination in Chinese AIIRDs patients. [Methods] Female patients with AIIRDs aged ≥ 9 years were enrolled between 1 April 2024 and 31 Aug 2024. Eligible participants completed a predefined 41-item questionnaire, which was distributed via social media invitations and in-person recruitment at outpatient clinics. We evaluated the demographics, rheumatic disease history, awareness of HPV infection and vaccination, HPV testing and vaccination status and willingness to receive HPV vaccine These factors were then compared between SLE and RA patients. [Results] A total of 562 participants with a median age of 34.9 (IQR 29.7–42.6) years completed the questionnaires. The awareness rates of HPV infection and vaccination were 82.0% and 85.9%, respectively. However, only 69.2% participants recognized the increased risk of cervical cancer associated with HPV, and just 52.3% had undergone cervical cancer screening in the past 5 years. Although 72.2% expressed willingness to receive the HPV vaccine, the actual vaccination rate was only 23.0%. Among the respondents, there were 334 SLE patients and 98 RA patients. Compared to RA patients, SLE patients were younger, had higher awareness of HPV vaccination, but a lower vaccination rate. [Conclusion] Patients with AIIRDs, SLE in particular, demonstrate high awareness of HPV infection and vaccination, as well as strong willingness to receive HPV vaccine. However, cervical cancer screening and actual HPV vaccination rates remain low.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated HPV vaccination awareness and status in Chinese women with autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRDs). title: Basic Clinical Bidirectional Empowerment: Synergistic Breakthrough in Molecular Mechanisms and Clinical Management of Small Cell Cervical Carcinoma
abstract: Small cell carcinoma of the cervix (SCCC) is a rare yet highly aggressive subtype of cervical cancer (CC), characterized by early invasion, high metastatic potential, frequent recurrence, and extremely poor prognosis, which severely impairs women’s physical and mental health. Currently, high-risk human papillomavirus (hr-HPV, particularly HPV18) infection is recognized as one of the core drivers underlying the initiation and progression of SCCC. Malignant evolution is not triggered by a single infection event but is cooperatively regulated at multiple molecular levels, including HPV genome integration, critical gene mutations, and aberrant activation of multiple signaling pathways. In addition, SCCC exhibits an HPV-independent oncogenic pathway mainly mediated by somatic mutations in tumor protein 53 (TP53) and retinoblastoma 1 (RB1), thus forming a dual pathogenic mechanism. Based on current clinical understanding and molecular mechanisms, this paper reviews the molecular pathogenesis and subtypes of SCCC, reveals the associations between tumor heterogeneity, therapeutic resistance, and metastasis, and proposes potential novel targets for the treatment of SCCC. This study innovatively presents a closed-loop model of two-way empowerment between basic research and clinical application. It emphasizes that basic research should be oriented toward real clinical problems and highlights the reciprocal feedback of clinical practice on basic research, thereby achieving dynamic iteration and collaborative breakthroughs in both fields.

Malignant evolution is not triggered by a single infection event but is cooperatively regulated at multiple molecular levels, including HPV genome integration, critical gene mutations, and aberrant activation of multiple signaling pathways. In addition, SCCC exhibits an HPV-independent oncogenic pathway mainly mediated by somatic mutations in tumor protein 53 (TP53) and retinoblastoma 1 (RB1), thus forming a dual pathogenic mechanism. Based on current clinical understanding and molecular mechanisms, this paper reviews the molecular pathogenesis and subtypes of SCCC, reveals the associations between tumor heterogeneity, therapeutic resistance, and metastasis, and proposes potential novel targets for the treatment of SCCC. This study innovatively presents a closed-loop model of two-way empowerment between basic research and clinical application. It emphasizes that basic research should be oriented toward real clinical problems and highlights the reciprocal feedback of clinical practice on basic research, thereby achieving dynamic iteration and collaborative breakthroughs in both fields.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注子宫颈小细胞癌 (SCCC),这是 宫颈癌 的一种罕见且具有侵袭性的亚型,检查其分子机制、临床管理和治疗靶点。核心问题围绕了解涉及高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 (hr-HPV) 和 HPV 独立致癌途径的双重致病机制。

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了 SCCC 发病机制 的复杂性,包括肿瘤异质性、治疗耐药性和转移,但没有明确解决相互矛盾的发现或具体的证据差距。HPV 独立途径的作用及其与 HPV 驱动机制的相互作用仍然是一个需要进一步阐明的领域。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述提出了 SCCC 的潜在新治疗靶点,并强调基础研究和临床实践之间动态迭代的必要性。它建议基础研究应面向临床实际问题,与临床实践相互反馈,推动协作突破。

abstract_zh: 子宫颈小细胞癌(SCCC)是宫颈癌(CC)中罕见但高度侵袭性的亚型,具有早期侵袭、高转移性、易复发、预后极差的特点,严重损害女性的身心健康。目前,高危人乳头瘤病毒(hr-HPV,特别是HPV18)感染被认为是SCCC发生和进展的核心驱动因素之一。恶性进化不是由单一感染事件触发的,而是在多个分子水平上协同调节,包括HPV 基因组整合、关键基因突变和多个信号通路的异常激活。此外,SCCC表现出不依赖于HPV的致癌途径,主要由肿瘤蛋白53(TP53)和视网膜母细胞瘤1(RB1)中的体细胞突变介导,从而形成双重致病机制。本文基于目前的临床认识和分子机制,对SCCC的分子治疗和亚型进行综述,揭示肿瘤异质性、治疗耐药和转移之间的关联,并提出SCCC 治疗的潜在新靶点。该研究创新性地提出了基础研究与临床应用双向赋能的闭环模式。强调基础研究要面向临床实际问题,突出临床实践对基础研究的相互反馈,从而实现两个领域的动态迭代和协同突破。

title: Jet Injections With Candida Antigen for Wart Treatment: An Alternative Drug Delivery.
abstract: Warts are a common pediatric condition caused by human papillomavirus. Immunotherapy is a well-studied treatment for warts and is classically administered via intralesional injection with a syringe and needle. We report a case of warts in a 12-year-old boy who achieved complete resolution following two sessions of pain-free, and needleless, intralesional Candida antigen administered using a needle free jet injection device. This is a less painful alternative for administration of intralesional immunotherapy, particularly useful in pediatric or needle phobic patients.
